title: Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations

paragraphs.en: Frontier AI evaluations increasingly use open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks whose transcripts can span hundreds of pages of outputs and actions from complex multi-agent networks. The observability envelope —the range of what evaluators can reliably infer about an agent’s behaviours—is therefore narrowing. Language model assistants can help classify and interpret agent behaviour but also afford human evaluators significant analytical degrees of freedom, threatening the reproducibility and auditability of language-model-based transcript analysis. Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript. Users specify task context and behavioural vocabulary in a reusable evaluation-family configuration, with judge models and analysis settings supplied separately. Transect’s navigable reports align recorded events, token use, sub-agent activity, and model-generated behavioural labels on a common turn-based timeline. Reviewers can quickly grasp a run’s narrative, trace any label or event to its source turns, and export the underlying data tables for cross-run analysis. We demonstrate the workflow on an AI R&D evaluation that generated almost 13 million tokens, dividing the agents’ work into behavioural phases aligned with research-skill classifications, sub-agent delegations and interactions, and token use. The combined view shows a focus on operational work and manuscript production, with little evidence of a sustained hypothesis generation stage—arguably a necessary component for high-quality scientific outputs. Transect’s flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: Frontier AI 评估越来越多地使用开放式、智能体驱动且长期限的任务，其转录文本可能包含来自复杂多智能体网络的数百页输出和行动记录。 因此，可观察性范围——即评估者能够可靠推断智能体行为的范围——正在不断缩小。 语言模型助手虽然有助于对智能体行为进行分类和解读，但也为人类评估者提供了较大的分析自由度，从而威胁到基于语言模型的转录分析的可重复性和可审计性。 Transect 是一个基于 Inspect Scout 构建的开源包，旨在帮助评估者了解智能体长时间运行的过程，识别值得进一步研究的行为，并将解读结果与转录文本进行对照验证。 用户可在可重用的评估家族配置中指定任务上下文和行为词汇表，而评判模型和分析设置则需单独提供。 Transect 的可导航报告将记录的事件、令牌使用、子智能体活动以及模型生成的行为标签对齐到统一的回合制时间线上。 评审者可以快速把握整个运行过程的脉络，追踪任何标签或事件对应的源回合，并导出底层数据表以进行跨运行分析。 我们通过一项 AI 研发评估演示了该工作流程：该评估生成了近 1300 万个令牌，并将智能体的工作划分为与研究技能分类、子智能体任务分配与交互以及令牌使用相对应的行为阶段。 综合视图显示，评估重点集中在操作工作和论文撰写上，而持续假设生成阶段的证据极少——这或许正是高质量科学成果所必需的一环。 Transect 灵活且可定制的转录分析流程将帮助评估者应对日益漫长、复杂和频繁的 AI 评估，同时保障科学的严谨性、透明度和可重复性。

paragraphs.en: Keywords LLM evaluation ⋅ \cdot transcript analysis ⋅ \cdot observability ⋅ \cdot AI safety ⋅ \cdot agentic evaluation ⋅ \cdot expert elicitation
paragraphs.zh: 关键词 LLM 评估 ⋅ \cdot 转录分析 ⋅ \cdot 可观察性 ⋅ \cdot AI 安全 ⋅ \cdot 智能体评估 ⋅ \cdot 专家意见提取

paragraphs.en: Three shifts are reshaping frontier AI evaluation. First, static benchmarks continue to saturate, limiting their usefulness for distinguishing the capabilities of frontier AI systems [ 1 ] . 1 1 1 Note that henceforth we use the term AI model to refer to the static set of network weights, AI agent to refer to a model that has access to a set of tools in an environment and can perform actions with them, and AI system to refer to the general infrastructure around and including that agent, including synchronous monitors, action classifiers, and multi-agent harnesses. Evaluation has therefore moved towards open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks in which AI agents plan, use tools, delegate to sub-agents, and act over many steps towards a goal, producing millions, sometimes billions , of tokens along the way [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Second, increasingly capable agents are arriving more frequently, leaving less time to scrutinise each system before the next appears, and agent capabilities can improve substantially between model releases [ 5 ] . Third, an agent’s measured performance can depend substantially on its token budget and opportunities to revise its work [ 6 , 7 ] . Evaluations are consequently becoming longer, more frequent, and more compute-intensive, imposing a growing burden on the human evaluators monitoring progress at the frontier.
paragraphs.zh: 三种轮班模式正在重塑前沿人工智能评估。 首先，静态基准测试持续趋于饱和，限制了它们在区分前沿人工智能系统能力方面的效用 [ 1 ] 。1 1 1 请注意，从今以后，我们将使用“AI模型”一词来指代静态的神经网络权重集合，“AI智能体”来指代能够访问环境中一系列工具并借助这些工具执行操作的模型，以及“AI系统”来指代围绕该智能体的整体基础设施（包括同步监控器、动作分类器和多智能体框架）。 因此，评估已转向开放式的、具有智能体特性的长期任务，在这些任务中，AI智能体会进行规划、使用工具、将任务委托给子智能体，并在多个步骤中朝着目标行动，在此过程中生成数百万甚至数十亿个标记 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 其次，能力越来越强的智能体出现得更加频繁，导致在下一个系统问世前可用于仔细审查每个系统的时间越来越少，而且不同模型版本之间的智能体能力也可能有显著提升 [ 5 ] 。 第三，智能体的实际表现可能在很大程度上取决于其标记预算以及修改自身工作的机会 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 因此，评估正变得更为漫长、频繁且计算密集，给监测前沿进展的人类评估者带来了日益沉重的负担。

paragraphs.en: We call the range of attributes an evaluator can reliably see or infer from an evaluation its observability envelope . This includes what an agent can do under the evaluation conditions, how dependably it performs, where and how it fails, and what propensities or dispositions it displays. The envelope depends on the evaluation apparatus as a whole: the transcript, the details of the AI system being evaluated (e.g., harness design), the transcript analysis methods, and those interpreting the evaluation evidence. There are at least four pressures on this observability envelope, increasing the risk that evaluators draw unjustified conclusions from transcripts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将评估者能够从评估中可靠地观察到或推断出的属性范围称为其可观察性边界。 这包括智能体在评估条件下能够执行的操作、其表现的可靠性程度、其失败的位置与方式，以及其所表现出的倾向或特性。 该边界取决于整个评估系统：包括评估记录、被评估人工智能系统的细节（例如，测试框架设计）、评估记录分析方法，以及对评估证据的解释者。 这种可观察性边界至少受到四种压力的影响，从而增加了评估者从评估记录中得出不合理结论的风险。

sents.en: There are at least four pressures on this observability envelope, increasing the risk that evaluators draw unjustified conclusions from transcripts.
sents.zh: 这种可观察性边界至少受到四种压力的影响，从而增加了评估者从评估记录中得出不合理结论的风险。

paragraphs.en: First, within-run opacity : a final score summarises performance on a long-horizon task but obscures discarded strategies, course corrections, recoveries, unexpected behaviors, and attempts to game the evaluation [ 8 ] . Second, a human attention bottleneck : reviewing hundreds or thousands of pages of agent activity requires scarce subject-matter expertise and the ability to connect and co-interpret complex events at distant points in a transcript [ 9 ] . Reviewer time cannot grow in proportion to transcript volume and model release cadence [ 10 , 11 ] . Third, insufficient statistical power : long agent evaluations are costly in time and resources, so evaluators can afford relatively few repetitions per agent and setup, leaving measurements based on final scores alone vulnerable to task variance, stochasticity, and isolated qualitative anecdotes [ 12 , 13 ] . Fourth, setup attribution uncertainty : observed performance is determined by both the model and the system it is embedded in [ 14 , 15 ] . Without observing an agent’s entire behavioural trajectory, it can be hard to assess the construct validity of an evaluation—whether the evaluation measures the intended capability rather than an artefact of its instruments or task setup [ 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，单次运行不透明度问题：最终得分虽然能概括长期任务中的表现，但却掩盖了被放弃的策略、路线调整、恢复过程、意外行为以及试图操纵评估的行为 [ 8 ]。 其次，人类注意力的瓶颈：要审查数百甚至数千页的智能体活动记录，既需要稀缺的专业知识，也需要能够关联并共同解读转录文本中不同时间点发生的复杂事件的能力 [ 9 ]。 评审者的时间无法与转录文本的体积和模型发布频率成比例增长 [ 10 , 11 ]。 第三，统计功效不足：对智能体的长期评估在时间和资源上都成本高昂，因此评估者对每个智能体和每种设置只能进行相对较少的重复测试，导致仅基于最终得分的测量容易受到任务方差、随机性和孤立定性事例的影响 [ 12 , 13 ]。 第四，设置归因的不确定性：观察到的表现既由模型决定，也由其嵌入的系统决定 [ 14 , 15 ]。 如果不观察智能体的完整行为轨迹，就很难评估一项评估的构念效度——即该评估衡量的是预期的能力，而非其工具或任务设置所产生的产物 [ 16 ]。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent evaluations further intensify these pressures on observability. Running agents in parallel can increase transcript volume within the same time budget, leaving more activity for reviewers to inspect. Interactions across agents and shared resources can make the course of the evaluation harder to follow. If an evaluation uses more total compute, fewer repetitions may be affordable within a fixed compute budget. Additional choices about multi-agent delegation and coordination can also make it harder to separate the effects of the model and its evaluation setup.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体评估进一步加剧了这些对可观察性的压力。 并行运行智能体会在相同的时间预算内增加转录文本的总量，从而留给评审员更多需要检查的活动。 智能体之间的交互以及对共享资源的使用，可能会使评估过程更难追踪。 如果评估使用的总计算量更大，那么在固定的计算预算内，可能无法负担更多的重复测试。 关于多智能体委托与协作的其他选择，也可能使得区分模型本身与其评估设置所产生的影响变得更加困难。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation community is aware of these pressures and has been building tooling to maintain and widen the observability envelope. Inspect AI and Inspect Scout provide primitives for recording, scanning, and querying evaluation traces, including with large language models [ 17 , 18 ] , while platforms such as Docent support interactive exploration of behavioural patterns across agent transcripts [ 19 ] . Another prominent approach is to use language model assistants with custom judging rubrics to aid transcript analysis [ 20 ] . However, such approaches introduce substantial researcher degrees of freedom, such as the judge model, rubric, unit of analysis (tool calls, chain of thought, chains of actions), and statistical analyses performed on top of these judgments. Analysts must therefore navigate a garden of forking paths in which defensible-seeming decisions accumulate into potentially unreproducible findings [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] . Model-assisted analysis can also make the evaluation more opaque rather than less: a judge produces yet more tokens to interpret, can overstate confidence, and its errors can be difficult to verify [ 24 , 25 ] . If findings about agent behaviour are to be trusted, these methods must be reproducible and the effect of arbitrary analytic choices must be measured. Otherwise, the tools intended to widen the observability envelope risk narrowing it further, replacing unread transcripts with unverifiable claims.
paragraphs.zh: 评估界意识到这些压力，并一直在开发工具以维持和扩展可观察性范围。 Inspect AI 和 Inspect Scout 提供了记录、扫描和查询评估轨迹的基础功能，包括使用大型语言模型 [ 17 , 18 ] ，而像 Docent 这样的平台则支持对智能体转录中的行为模式进行交互式探索 [ 19 ] 。 另一种重要的方法是使用带有自定义评判标准的语言模型助手来辅助转录分析 [ 20 ] 。 然而，这类方法引入了研究人员相当大的自由度，例如评判模型、评判标准、分析单位（工具调用、思维链、行动链）以及基于这些评判所进行的统计分析。 因此，分析师必须在一个充满分岔路径的复杂环境中进行判断，其中看似合理的决策会累积成可能无法复现的研究结果 [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。 模型辅助分析也可能使评估过程变得更不透明而非更透明：评判模型会产生更多需要解读的标记，可能夸大其置信度，且其错误往往难以验证 [ 24 , 25 ] 。 如果希望智能体行为的研究结果值得信赖，这些方法必须具有可复现性，并且任意分析选择所带来的影响也必须得到衡量。 否则，那些旨在扩展可观察性范围的工具反而可能进一步缩小这一范围，用无法验证的断言取代难以解读的转录记录。

sents.en: The evaluation community is aware of these pressures and has been building tooling to maintain and widen the observability envelope.
sents.zh: 评估界意识到这些压力，并一直在开发工具以维持和扩展可观察性范围。

sents.en: Inspect AI and Inspect Scout provide primitives for recording, scanning, and querying evaluation traces, including with large language models [ 17 , 18 ] , while platforms such as Docent support interactive exploration of behavioural patterns across agent transcripts [ 19 ] .
sents.zh: Inspect AI 和 Inspect Scout 提供了记录、扫描和查询评估轨迹的基础功能，包括使用大型语言模型 [ 17 , 18 ] ，而像 Docent 这样的平台则支持对智能体转录中的行为模式进行交互式探索 [ 19 ] 。

sents.en: Another prominent approach is to use language model assistants with custom judging rubrics to aid transcript analysis [ 20 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种重要的方法是使用带有自定义评判标准的语言模型助手来辅助转录分析 [ 20 ] 。

sents.en: However, such approaches introduce substantial researcher degrees of freedom, such as the judge model, rubric, unit of analysis (tool calls, chain of thought, chains of actions), and statistical analyses performed on top of these judgments.
sents.zh: 然而，这类方法引入了研究人员相当大的自由度，例如评判模型、评判标准、分析单位（工具调用、思维链、行动链）以及基于这些评判所进行的统计分析。

sents.en: Analysts must therefore navigate a garden of forking paths in which defensible-seeming decisions accumulate into potentially unreproducible findings [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
sents.zh: 因此，分析师必须在一个充满分岔路径的复杂环境中进行判断，其中看似合理的决策会累积成可能无法复现的研究结果 [ 21 , 22 , 23 ] 。

sents.en: Model-assisted analysis can also make the evaluation more opaque rather than less: a judge produces yet more tokens to interpret, can overstate confidence, and its errors can be difficult to verify [ 24 , 25 ] .
sents.zh: 模型辅助分析也可能使评估过程变得更不透明而非更透明：评判模型会产生更多需要解读的标记，可能夸大其置信度，且其错误往往难以验证 [ 24 , 25 ] 。

sents.en: If findings about agent behaviour are to be trusted, these methods must be reproducible and the effect of arbitrary analytic choices must be measured.
sents.zh: 如果希望智能体行为的研究结果值得信赖，这些方法必须具有可复现性，并且任意分析选择所带来的影响也必须得到衡量。

sents.en: Otherwise, the tools intended to widen the observability envelope risk narrowing it further, replacing unread transcripts with unverifiable claims.
sents.zh: 否则，那些旨在扩展可观察性范围的工具反而可能进一步缩小这一范围，用无法验证的断言取代难以解读的转录记录。

paragraphs.en: We present Transect , a transcript analysis package designed to address within-run opacity and the human attention bottleneck. Its shared, source-linked account helps evaluators understand how a run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check their interpretations against the transcript. Reviewers can also use this account to investigate setup attribution uncertainty, although separating the effects of the model and its evaluation setup requires further evidence. Its structured outputs also support comparisons across runs, though they do not resolve insufficient statistical power when too few independent evaluations are available.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Transect，这是一个转录分析工具包，旨在解决单次运行中的不透明性问题以及人类注意力瓶颈。 其共享的、与源数据关联的记录有助于评估者了解单次运行的展开过程，识别值得进一步研究的行为，并将他们的解释与转录记录进行对照验证。 评审者也可以使用这一记录来探究设置归因的不确定性，尽管要区分模型及其评估设置的影响，还需要更多证据支持。 其结构化输出还支持跨次运行的比较，但当可用独立评估数量过少时，这些输出无法解决统计功效不足的问题。

sents.zh: 我们提出了 Transect，这是一个转录分析工具包，旨在解决单次运行中的不透明性问题以及人类注意力瓶颈。

sents.zh: 其结构化输出还支持跨次运行的比较，但当可用独立评估数量过少时，这些输出无法解决统计功效不足的问题。

paragraphs.en: The analyst supplies a reusable configuration for the evaluation family detailing the information they need to extract, along with LLM judge rubrics and model specifications that will help them do so. Built on Inspect Scout [ 18 ] , Transect analyses Inspect evaluation logs [ 17 ] or supported OpenClaw exports [ 26 ] . It extracts recorded events and uses the selected judges to classify activities, producing a report organised along a shared timeline and structured tables for further analysis. Reviewers can follow the course of the evaluation, examine activities alongside token use and sub-agent deployments, and follow labels and events directly back to the source in the transcript without assembling separate scanner outputs themselves. This connects the overall account of an evaluation to the details needed to investigate an unexpected behaviour, a possible safety incident, or a constraint imposed by the evaluation setup.
paragraphs.zh: 分析师为评估系列提供可重复使用的配置，其中详细说明了需要提取的信息，以及有助于完成此任务的 LLM 评判标准卡和模型规范。 Transect 基于 Inspect Scout [ 18 ] 构建，用于分析 Inspect 评估日志 [ 17 ] 或受支持的 OpenClaw 导出文件 [ 26 ] 。 它能提取记录的事件，并使用选定的评判标准对活动进行分类，生成一份按共享时间线组织、以结构化表格呈现的报告，以便进一步分析。 评审员可以追踪评估的整个过程，将活动与令牌使用情况和子智能体部署一同查看，并直接通过标签和事件追溯到转录文本中的原始来源，而无需自行整合独立的扫描器输出。 这将评估的整体情况与调查意外行为、潜在的安全事件或评估设置所施加限制所需的具体细节联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Reproducible analysis requires retaining the source transcripts, run selection, family configuration, judging settings, custom analysis code and stored results, and recording software and model versions where available ( Section A.7 ). Independent evaluators can re-examine stored results without new judge calls, although rerunning the judges may produce different labels. The shared judging machinery records judge identities and decisions, with diagnostics of within-model stability or between-model agreement where the judging regime supports them. Of course, this information alone does not establish whether the labels are correct. These records and checks support Transect’s aim of scaling oversight responsibly: increasing analytical capacity while preserving the means to assess its findings.
paragraphs.zh: 可重复的分析需要保留原始转录文本、运行选择、家族配置、评判设置、自定义分析代码和存储结果，并在可能的情况下记录软件和模型版本（第 A.7 节）。 独立评估者无需重新调用评判器即可重新检查已存储的结果，尽管重新运行评判器可能会产生不同的标签。 共享的评判机制会记录评判者的身份和决策，并在评判体系支持的情况下，对模型内部的稳定性或模型之间的共识进行诊断。 当然，仅凭这些信息本身并不能确定这些标签是否正确。 这些记录和检查有助于实现 Transect 的目标：以负责任的方式扩展监督范围，即在提升分析能力的同时保留评估其发现结果的手段。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of the paper describes Transect’s pipeline and design principles ( Section 2 ), then illustrates the workflow on a long-horizon AI R&D shadow evaluation with extensive sub-agent activity ( Section 3 ). The case examines research activities and token expenditure, uses custom scanners to trace shared-file accesses across agents, and combines scanner outputs into additional report views. A full technical reference appears in Appendix A , and the implementation is openly available at https://github.com/AI-Safety-Institute/transect .
paragraphs.zh: 本文其余部分将描述 Transect 的流程与设计原则（第 2 节），随后通过一个长期人工智能研发场景的模拟评估，展示其工作流程，其中涉及大量子智能体的活动（第 3 节）。 该案例研究分析了研究活动与代币消耗情况，使用自定义扫描器追踪智能体之间的共享文件访问行为，并将扫描结果整合为额外的报告视图。 完整的技术参考资料见附录 A，其实现代码可在 https://github.com/AI-Safety-Institute/transect 公开获取。

paragraphs.en: Transect turns an evaluation transcript into a navigable account of the agent’s activities with direct links to their source. We describe the pipeline ( Section 2.1 ) and the principles guiding its configuration and interpretation ( Section 2.2 ), then work through one AI R&D run to show how a reviewer can use the report ( Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Transect 将评估记录转化为一份可导航的智能体活动记录，并附有直接指向原始来源的链接。 我们介绍了该流程（第 2.1 节）以及指导其配置和解读的原则（第 2.2 节），然后通过一个 AI 研发实例，展示评审员如何使用该报告（第 3 节）。

sents.en: Transect turns an evaluation transcript into a navigable account of the agent’s activities with direct links to their source.
sents.zh: Transect 将评估记录转化为一份可导航的智能体活动记录，并附有直接指向原始来源的链接。

sents.en: We describe the pipeline ( Section 2.1 ) and the principles guiding its configuration and interpretation ( Section 2.2 ), then work through one AI R&D run to show how a reviewer can use the report ( Section 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们介绍了该流程（第 2.1 节）以及指导其配置和解读的原则（第 2.2 节），然后通过一个 AI 研发实例，展示评审员如何使用该报告（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Transect builds on Inspect Scout’s transcript and scanner primitives [ 18 ] ( Appendix A ). The pipeline starts with a completed run transcript and a Spec : a reusable configuration for an evaluation family (e.g., a cyber-security range or an AI R&D evaluation). A Spec is used for every evaluation family, whether or not the analysis calls language models. It can contain task context, activity definitions, sub-agent role categories where relevant, and user-defined content for custom analyses. Its contents vary with the task and the user’s questions: sub-agent categories, for example, are needed only when classifying sub-agent roles. The package includes skills for coding assistants to guide Spec authoring and refinement. The user starts from the evaluation brief and setup materials, identifies missing information, and seeks clarification from evaluation designers or subject-matter experts. For classification, the user supplies the categories and definitions, and language model scanners use them to label the transcript. The user can also add custom structural scanners to extract recorded information and custom judged scanners to classify behaviour ( Section A.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: Transect 在 Inspect Scout 的转录本和扫描器基础组件 [ 18 ]（附录 A）的基础上进行了扩展。 该流程始于一个已完成的运行转录本和一个 Spec：即用于评估系列的可重复使用配置（例如，网络安全测试环境或人工智能研发评估）。 每个评估系列都会使用一个 Spec，无论分析过程是否调用语言模型。 Spec 可以包含任务上下文、活动定义、相关子智能体角色类别，以及用于自定义分析的自定义内容。 其具体内容因任务和用户问题而异：例如，仅在需要分类子智能体角色时，才需要子智能体类别。 该包包含编码辅助工具的技能，以指导 Spec 的编写与优化。 用户从评估简报和设置材料入手，识别缺失信息，并向评估设计师或领域专家寻求澄清。 在分类过程中，用户提供类别和定义，语言模型扫描器则利用这些信息进行转录本标注。 用户还可以添加自定义结构扫描器以提取记录信息，以及自定义判断扫描器以分类行为（第 A.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: The broader pipeline configuration also includes separately supplied analysis settings, such as judge models and whether and how they may interact (see Section A.1 ). Transect supports one pass by a single model (solo), repeated passes by that model ( k k -rolls), or a cohort of models making separate judgments ( Section A.5 ). These choices specify how to analyse the run, while the Spec describes evaluation content and context. Transect retains the supplied judging settings in its stored scanner configuration, alongside records of the judging regime and results, for later inspection ( Section A.7 ). Transect returns a TransectResults object containing dataframes , the structured tables underlying a navigable report ( Section A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛的流程配置还包括单独提供的分析设置，例如评判模型以及这些模型是否可以互动及其互动方式（参见第 A.1 节）。 Transect 支持由单个模型执行一次分析（solo）、由该模型重复执行多次分析（k-roll），或由一组模型分别做出判断（第 A.5 节）。 这些选项指定了如何对运行过程进行分析，而 Spec 则描述了评估内容和上下文。 Transect 会将提供的评判设置保留在存储的扫描器配置中，同时保存评判机制和结果的记录，以便后续查看（第 A.7 节）。 Transect 会返回一个 TransectResults 对象，其中包含数据框，即构成可导航报告的基础结构化表格（第 A.3 节）。

sents.zh: 更广泛的流程配置还包括单独提供的分析设置，例如评判模型以及这些模型是否可以互动及其互动方式（参见第 A.1 节）。

sents.en: Transect supports one pass by a single model (solo), repeated passes by that model ( k k -rolls), or a cohort of models making separate judgments ( Section A.5 ).
sents.zh: Transect 支持由单个模型执行一次分析（solo）、由该模型重复执行多次分析（k-roll），或由一组模型分别做出判断（第 A.5 节）。

sents.en: These choices specify how to analyse the run, while the Spec describes evaluation content and context.
sents.zh: 这些选项指定了如何对运行过程进行分析，而 Spec 则描述了评估内容和上下文。

sents.en: Transect retains the supplied judging settings in its stored scanner configuration, alongside records of the judging regime and results, for later inspection ( Section A.7 ).
sents.zh: Transect 会将提供的评判设置保留在存储的扫描器配置中，同时保存评判机制和结果的记录，以便后续查看（第 A.7 节）。

sents.en: Transect returns a TransectResults object containing dataframes , the structured tables underlying a navigable report ( Section A.3 ).
sents.zh: Transect 会返回一个 TransectResults 对象，其中包含数据框，即构成可导航报告的基础结构化表格（第 A.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The report helps reviewers locate episodes that warrant inspection, compare token use across activities, and investigate how recorded events relate to changes in behaviour. For example, reviewers can examine whether a shift in activity occurs near a context compaction and follow both back to the transcript. These features address the human attention bottleneck and within-run opacity , and help investigate how the evaluation setup shaped a run ( Section 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该报告有助于评审人员定位需要检查的片段，比较不同活动中标记的使用情况，并探究记录的事件如何与行为变化相关联。 例如，评审人员可以检查活动变化是否发生在上下文压缩附近，并追溯两者至原始转录文本。 这些功能解决了人类注意力的瓶颈以及单次运行中的不透明性问题，并有助于探究评估设置如何影响了一次运行（第 1 节）。

sents.en: The report helps reviewers locate episodes that warrant inspection, compare token use across activities, and investigate how recorded events relate to changes in behaviour.
sents.zh: 该报告有助于评审人员定位需要检查的片段，比较不同活动中标记的使用情况，并探究记录的事件如何与行为变化相关联。

sents.zh: 例如，评审人员可以检查活动变化是否发生在上下文压缩附近，并追溯两者至原始转录文本。

sents.zh: 这些功能解决了人类注意力的瓶颈以及单次运行中的不透明性问题，并有助于探究评估设置如何影响了一次运行（第 1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows the five stages. Ingest places the run on a shared turn axis, with one turn per agent output, so later signals use the same index across source formats. The axis records output order; the elapsed time between outputs can vary. Select chooses the sample and one or more epochs to analyse. 2 2 2 A sample is a task instance with a specified prompt and evaluation setup; an epoch is one attempt at that sample. Scan runs the scanners. Store assembles their results into Transect’s dataframes. Render produces the report, linking scanner outputs to their source turns in the transcript. Users can export the returned dataframes and combine them across epochs for their own analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了五个阶段。 Ingest 将运行置于共享的轮次轴上，每个智能体输出对应一个轮次，因此后续信号在不同源格式中会使用相同的索引。 该轴记录输出顺序；各输出之间的经过时间可能不同。 Select 选择样本以及一个或多个用于分析的周期。2 2 2 样本是一个带有指定提示和评估设置的实例任务；周期是对该样本的一次尝试。Scan 运行扫描器。 Store 将其结果整合到 Transect 的数据框中。 Render 生成报告，将扫描器的输出与转录本中对应的源轮次关联起来。 用户可以导出返回的数据框，并在不同周期之间合并它们以进行自己的分析。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows the five stages.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了五个阶段。

sents.en: Ingest places the run on a shared turn axis, with one turn per agent output, so later signals use the same index across source formats.
sents.zh: Ingest 将运行置于共享的轮次轴上，每个智能体输出对应一个轮次，因此后续信号在不同源格式中会使用相同的索引。

sents.en: Select chooses the sample and one or more epochs to analyse. 2 2 2 A sample is a task instance with a specified prompt and evaluation setup; an epoch is one attempt at that sample. Scan runs the scanners.
sents.zh: Select 选择样本以及一个或多个用于分析的周期。2 2 2 样本是一个带有指定提示和评估设置的实例任务；周期是对该样本的一次尝试。Scan 运行扫描器。

sents.en: Store assembles their results into Transect’s dataframes.
sents.zh: Store 将其结果整合到 Transect 的数据框中。

sents.en: Render produces the report, linking scanner outputs to their source turns in the transcript.
sents.zh: Render 生成报告，将扫描器的输出与转录本中对应的源轮次关联起来。

sents.en: Users can export the returned dataframes and combine them across epochs for their own analyses.
sents.zh: 用户可以导出返回的数据框，并在不同周期之间合并它们以进行自己的分析。

paragraphs.en: A scanner extracts information or classifies behaviour from a transcript. In Figure 1 , structural scanners extract recorded information, such as context compactions, operator messages, and per-turn token use, without calling a language model. Judged scanners call the language models selected for the analysis to classify, rate, or annotate the evaluated agent’s behaviour. The AI R&D analysis below combines recorded operator messages and context compactions with research-activity labels from a custom judged scanner ( Figure 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 扫描器从转录文本中提取信息或分类行为。 在图 1 中，结构扫描器提取记录的信息（例如上下文压缩、操作员消息和每轮对话的标记使用情况），而无需调用语言模型。 判断扫描器会调用为分析所选的语言模型，对受评估智能体的行为进行分类、评分或标注。 下方的 AI 研发分析将记录的操作员消息和上下文压缩与来自自定义判断扫描器的研究活动标签相结合（图 2）。

sents.en: A scanner extracts information or classifies behaviour from a transcript.
sents.zh: 扫描器从转录文本中提取信息或分类行为。

sents.en: In Figure 1 , structural scanners extract recorded information, such as context compactions, operator messages, and per-turn token use, without calling a language model.
sents.zh: 在图 1 中，结构扫描器提取记录的信息（例如上下文压缩、操作员消息和每轮对话的标记使用情况），而无需调用语言模型。

sents.en: Judged scanners call the language models selected for the analysis to classify, rate, or annotate the evaluated agent’s behaviour.
sents.zh: 判断扫描器会调用为分析所选的语言模型，对受评估智能体的行为进行分类、评分或标注。

sents.en: The AI R&D analysis below combines recorded operator messages and context compactions with research-activity labels from a custom judged scanner ( Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 下方的 AI 研发分析将记录的操作员消息和上下文压缩与来自自定义判断扫描器的研究活动标签相结合（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: The built-in judged scanners run when judge models and the required Spec vocabularies are supplied. The decision_phases scanner divides the run into contiguous phases and labels them using a closed, pre-registered vocabulary based on the Spec, reusable across samples and epochs of the same family. The subagent_classification scanner labels sub-agents from their delegation instructions: what the orchestrator asked them to do, which may differ from what they actually did.
paragraphs.zh: 内置的 judged 扫描器在提供 judge 模型和所需的 Spec 词汇表时运行。 decision_phases 扫描器将运行过程划分为连续的阶段，并使用基于 Spec 的封闭、预注册的词汇表对这些阶段进行标记；该词汇表可在同一族样本和周期中重复使用。 subagent_classification 扫描器根据子智能体的委托指令对其加以标记：即协调器要求它们执行的任务，这可能与它们实际执行的任务有所不同。

sents.en: The built-in judged scanners run when judge models and the required Spec vocabularies are supplied.
sents.zh: 内置的 judged 扫描器在提供 judge 模型和所需的 Spec 词汇表时运行。

sents.en: The decision_phases scanner divides the run into contiguous phases and labels them using a closed, pre-registered vocabulary based on the Spec, reusable across samples and epochs of the same family.
sents.zh: decision_phases 扫描器将运行过程划分为连续的阶段，并使用基于 Spec 的封闭、预注册的词汇表对这些阶段进行标记；该词汇表可在同一族样本和周期中重复使用。

sents.en: The subagent_classification scanner labels sub-agents from their delegation instructions: what the orchestrator asked them to do, which may differ from what they actually did.
sents.zh: subagent_classification 扫描器根据子智能体的委托指令对其加以标记：即协调器要求它们执行的任务，这可能与它们实际执行的任务有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Users can add custom structural or judged scanners to address further evaluation questions. For bespoke classification questions, the public cohort_llm_scanner helper gives a custom scanner the same judging machinery as the built-in scanners: voting across repeated judgments or multiple judges and a per-judgment provenance record identifying the judges, their individual answers, and any verifier changes. In solo and k-roll regimes, a verifier model can review selected classifications in an optional second round and revise their labels. Selection uses low-confidence or low-agreement triggers and random spot-checks. Nonetheless, these outputs remain fallible model judgments. Depending on the judging regime, they carry a model’s stated confidence, within-model stability, or between-model agreement ( Section A.5 ). While stability and agreement help assess the reliability of a judgment or classification, they do not establish validity, as that would require comparison to a ground truth (usually, a human expert’s validated judgement). The reviewer ultimately remains responsible for judging what the evidence supports.
paragraphs.zh: 用户可以添加自定义的结构化或判读扫描器，以解决进一步的评估问题。 对于定制分类问题，公共的 cohort_llm_scanner 辅助工具为自定义扫描器提供了与内置扫描器相同的判读机制：通过重复判读或多个判读者进行投票，并记录每次判读的来源信息，包括判读者、他们的个人答案以及任何验证器的变更。 在单人判读和 k-roll 判读模式下，验证模型可以在可选的第二轮中审查选定的分类结果，并修改其标签。 选择过程会利用低置信度或低一致性的触发条件，以及随机的抽查。 尽管如此，这些输出仍然是可能出错的模型判读结果。 根据判读模式的不同，这些结果会包含模型声明的置信度、模型内部稳定性或模型间一致性（见第 A.5 节）。 虽然稳定性和一致性有助于评估判读或分类的可靠性，但它们并不能确立有效性，因为有效性需要与基准真相（通常是经过验证的人类专家的判读）进行比较。 最终，审核者仍需对证据所支持的内容作出判断并承担责任。

sents.zh: 用户可以添加自定义的结构化或判读扫描器，以解决进一步的评估问题。

sents.en: While stability and agreement help assess the reliability of a judgment or classification, they do not establish validity, as that would require comparison to a ground truth (usually, a human expert’s validated judgement).

paragraphs.en: Three design principles guide how the analysis is configured, interpreted, and extended. The first is to configure analysis for the evaluation family . Each family’s Spec can define the behavioural vocabulary and any relevant sub-agent categories used to interpret its runs, drawing on evaluation materials and, where needed, subject matter expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 三项设计原则指导了分析的配置、解释和扩展方式。 第一项是为评估族配置分析。 每个族的规范都可以定义其行为词汇表以及用于解释其运行结果的任何相关子智能体类别，这些定义可以借鉴评估材料，并在需要时参考领域专业知识。

sents.en: Three design principles guide how the analysis is configured, interpreted, and extended.
sents.zh: 三项设计原则指导了分析的配置、解释和扩展方式。

sents.en: The first is to configure analysis for the evaluation family .
sents.zh: 第一项是为评估族配置分析。

sents.en: Each family’s Spec can define the behavioural vocabulary and any relevant sub-agent categories used to interpret its runs, drawing on evaluation materials and, where needed, subject matter expertise.
sents.zh: 每个族的规范都可以定义其行为词汇表以及用于解释其运行结果的任何相关子智能体类别，这些定义可以借鉴评估材料，并在需要时参考领域专业知识。

paragraphs.en: The second is structured expert elicitation [ 27 , 28 ] . Users can ask a coding assistant, guided by the package’s skills, to flag missing task context or unclear category definitions and help prepare questions for subject-matter experts (SMEs). Experts can then supply information missing from the evaluation materials, such as outcomes of interest, and review proposed classification rubrics. Transect records the category labels and definitions used by its built-in judged scanners. These records let users inspect the applied rubric and compare revisions across analyses.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种方法是结构化专家征询法 [ 27 , 28 ] 。 用户可以借助编码助手，在软件包技能指导下，标记缺失的任务上下文或不清的类别定义，并协助为领域专家（SME）准备问题。 随后，专家可以提供评估材料中缺失的信息，例如关注的结果，并审查拟定的分类评分标准。 Transect 会记录其内置的判定扫描器所使用的类别标签和定义。 这些记录使用户能够检查所应用的评分标准，并比较不同分析中的修订版本。

sents.en: The second is structured expert elicitation [ 27 , 28 ] .
sents.zh: 第二种方法是结构化专家征询法 [ 27 , 28 ] 。

sents.en: Users can ask a coding assistant, guided by the package’s skills, to flag missing task context or unclear category definitions and help prepare questions for subject-matter experts (SMEs).
sents.zh: 用户可以借助编码助手，在软件包技能指导下，标记缺失的任务上下文或不清的类别定义，并协助为领域专家（SME）准备问题。

sents.en: Experts can then supply information missing from the evaluation materials, such as outcomes of interest, and review proposed classification rubrics.
sents.zh: 随后，专家可以提供评估材料中缺失的信息，例如关注的结果，并审查拟定的分类评分标准。

sents.en: Transect records the category labels and definitions used by its built-in judged scanners.
sents.zh: Transect 会记录其内置的判定扫描器所使用的类别标签和定义。

sents.en: These records let users inspect the applied rubric and compare revisions across analyses.
sents.zh: 这些记录使用户能够检查所应用的评分标准，并比较不同分析中的修订版本。

paragraphs.en: The third is automation. The package’s skills and worked examples guide coding assistants in running analyses and adding scanners or report views. They are designed to reduce the work needed to adapt the pipeline as evaluation tasks change. For a new family, users can supply a different Spec and add analyses while reusing the existing pipeline for supported transcript formats. The diagnostics skill helps users inspect disagreements, check the recorded judging setup and test sensitivity to the Spec’s category names while keeping their definitions fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 第三项是自动化。 该软件包中的技能和示例代码可指导编码助手执行分析，并添加扫描器或报告视图。 这些设计旨在减少在评估任务变化时调整流程所需的工作量。 对于新的数据组，用户可以提供不同的规范，并在重新使用现有流程处理支持的转录格式的同时添加分析。 诊断技能可帮助用户检查分歧、核对已记录的判断设置，并在保持定义不变的情况下测试对规范中类别名称的敏感度。

sents.en: The third is automation.
sents.zh: 第三项是自动化。

sents.en: The package’s skills and worked examples guide coding assistants in running analyses and adding scanners or report views.
sents.zh: 该软件包中的技能和示例代码可指导编码助手执行分析，并添加扫描器或报告视图。

sents.en: They are designed to reduce the work needed to adapt the pipeline as evaluation tasks change.
sents.zh: 这些设计旨在减少在评估任务变化时调整流程所需的工作量。

sents.en: For a new family, users can supply a different Spec and add analyses while reusing the existing pipeline for supported transcript formats.
sents.zh: 对于新的数据组，用户可以提供不同的规范，并在重新使用现有流程处理支持的转录格式的同时添加分析。

sents.en: The diagnostics skill helps users inspect disagreements, check the recorded judging setup and test sensitivity to the Spec’s category names while keeping their definitions fixed.
sents.zh: 诊断技能可帮助用户检查分歧、核对已记录的判断设置，并在保持定义不变的情况下测试对规范中类别名称的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: A custom report layer draws on the same dataframes to add a new view ( Appendix A ). A design requirement is that report views preserve the available diagnostics and provenance of judged outputs. The report displays available confidence and agreement diagnostics and flags potential reliability problems. Provenance information helps reviewers understand the source of scanner judgements, and reliability information helps them assess what conclusions these judgements can support.
paragraphs.zh: 自定义报告层利用相同的数据框来添加新的视图（附录 A）。 一项设计要求是，报告视图必须保留可用诊断信息和已判断输出的来源信息。 该报告显示可用的置信度和一致性诊断信息，并标记潜在的可靠性问题。 来源信息有助于审阅者了解扫描仪判断的来源，而可靠性信息则有助于他们评估这些判断能够支持哪些结论。

sents.en: A custom report layer draws on the same dataframes to add a new view ( Appendix A ).
sents.zh: 自定义报告层利用相同的数据框来添加新的视图（附录 A）。

sents.en: A design requirement is that report views preserve the available diagnostics and provenance of judged outputs.
sents.zh: 一项设计要求是，报告视图必须保留可用诊断信息和已判断输出的来源信息。

sents.en: The report displays available confidence and agreement diagnostics and flags potential reliability problems.
sents.zh: 该报告显示可用的置信度和一致性诊断信息，并标记潜在的可靠性问题。

sents.en: Provenance information helps reviewers understand the source of scanner judgements, and reliability information helps them assess what conclusions these judgements can support.
sents.zh: 来源信息有助于审阅者了解扫描仪判断的来源，而可靠性信息则有助于他们评估这些判断能够支持哪些结论。

paragraphs.en: Transect builds on Inspect AI for evaluation-log access and judge-model interfaces, and on Inspect Scout for transcript representation, scanner execution and stored results [ 17 , 29 , 18 ] . Inspect Viz supplies the report’s interactive charts. 3 3 3 https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_viz/ . Transect organises these components around an evaluation family and enables co-interpretation of multiple scanner outputs on a shared timeline.
paragraphs.zh: Transect 在 Inspect AI 的基础上构建，用于访问评估日志和判断模型接口；同时基于 Inspect Scout 实现转录表示、扫描器执行和结果存储 [ 17 , 29 , 18 ] 。 Inspect Viz 提供报告中的交互式图表。 3 3 3 https://meridianlabs-ai.github.io/inspect_viz/ 。 Transect 围绕一个评估系列组织这些组件，并支持在共享时间轴上对多个扫描器输出进行协同解读。

sents.en: Transect builds on Inspect AI for evaluation-log access and judge-model interfaces, and on Inspect Scout for transcript representation, scanner execution and stored results [ 17 , 29 , 18 ] .
sents.zh: Transect 在 Inspect AI 的基础上构建，用于访问评估日志和判断模型接口；同时基于 Inspect Scout 实现转录表示、扫描器执行和结果存储 [ 17 , 29 , 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Docent is another prominent transcript analysis tool which uses language model assistants to help users interactively navigate through transcripts [ 30 ] . Transect, in contrast, supplies a reusable analysis and reporting pipeline: users can apply a family Spec and their chosen judging settings across samples and epochs. The package’s coding-assistant skills help users add analyses or views for new questions while reusing shared tables and report interfaces. Platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases Weave, and AgentOps support trace inspection, debugging and application monitoring; LangSmith and Langfuse also support offline experiments and online evaluation. 4 4 4 https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/evaluation ; https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/overview ; https://arize.com/docs/phoenix ; https://docs.wandb.ai/weave ; https://docs.agentops.ai/ .
paragraphs.zh: Docent 是另一款著名的转录分析工具，它利用语言模型助手帮助用户交互式地浏览转录内容 [ 30 ] 。 相比之下，Transect 提供了一个可重复使用的分析和报告流程：用户可以将一个家族 Spec 和所选的评判设置应用于多个样本和时期。 该包的编码助手功能可以帮助用户为新问题添加分析或视图，同时复用共享表格和报告界面。 LangSmith、Langfuse、Arize Phoenix、Weights & Biases Weave 和 AgentOps 等平台支持追踪检查、调试和应用监控；LangSmith 和 Langfuse 还支持离线实验和在线评估。 4 4 4 https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/evaluation ; https://langfuse.com/docs/evaluation/overview ; https://arize.com/docs/phoenix ; https://docs.wandb.ai/weave ; https://docs.agentops.ai/ .

paragraphs.en: Transect brings family-defined activity labels, recorded events and token use together on an interactive turn-level timeline, so reviewers can examine how these signals relate within a run and follow them to the source transcript. Transect’s contribution is to combine adaptable analysis, interactive evidence review and inspectable model judgements in one reusable workflow for long-horizon evaluations. Methods for statistical analysis and evaluation design are complementary [ 12 , 31 ] , since Transect structures within-run evidence for such analysis but does not make sparse observations statistically sufficient.
paragraphs.zh: Transect 将家庭定义的活动标签、记录的事件和代币使用情况整合到交互式回合级时间线中，使评审人员能够考察这些信号在一次运行中的关联，并追溯至原始转录文本。 Transect 的贡献在于将可适应的分析、交互式的证据审查和可检验的模型判断整合到一个可重复使用的流程中，以支持长期评估。 统计分析方法和评估设计方法具有互补性 [ 12 , 31 ]，因为 Transect 为此类分析组织了一次运行内的证据，但并未使稀疏的观察结果在统计上变得充分。

paragraphs.en: AI research and development (R&D) is a prototypical example of an open-ended, long-horizon task for frontier agents. AI R&D evaluations measure whether current agents can perform machine learning research that might accelerate AI development, including through so-called recursive self-improvement [ 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] . Such evaluations exemplify the difficulties of maintaining observability on agent behaviour. An agent may operate autonomously for days or weeks, generate billions of tokens, execute thousands of tool calls, and delegate work to hundreds of sub-agents [ 36 ] . It is also unclear what successful behaviour looks like, since “doing good science” is a fuzzy construct [ 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] , and the final artefact is a written paper or report, whose quality may conceal many issues during its construction, including data fabrication, citation hallucination, and deep conceptual misunderstandings [ 41 , 42 , 43 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能研究开发（R&D）是前沿智能体所面临的开放、长期任务的典型范例。 人工智能研究开发的评估旨在检验当前智能体是否能够开展可能加速人工智能发展的机器学习研究，包括通过所谓的递归自我改进 [ 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] 。 此类评估凸显了维持对智能体行为可观察性的困难。 一个智能体可能自主运行数日或数周，生成数十亿个词元，执行数千次工具调用，并将任务委托给数百个子智能体 [ 36 ] 。 此外，成功的行为表现尚不明确，因为“开展优秀的科学研究”是一个模糊的概念 [ 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] ，而最终成果是一篇书面论文或报告，其质量可能掩盖了构建过程中存在的诸多问题，包括数据伪造、引用幻觉和深层概念误解 [ 41 , 42 , 43 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We illustrate Transect on a single sample of the CRUX initiative’s shadow evaluations [ 44 ] . In these evaluations, an agent receives a research brief based on a complete but unpublished human-written machine-learning research paper and is asked to produce a finished manuscript. A human operator is available over a Telegram chat interface to resolve operational problems but does not direct the research process itself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过 CRUX 计划影子评估中的一个样本来展示 Transect [44]。 在这些评估中，一个智能体会收到一份基于完整但未发表的人类撰写的机器学习研究论文的研究简报，并被要求生成一篇完整的论文手稿。 一名人类操作员可通过 Telegram 聊天界面解决操作问题，但不会指导研究过程本身。

paragraphs.en: The brief for this sample poses a methods problem in tabular prior-fitted networks (PFNs), transformers that classify tabular data through in-context learning over a support set rather than task-specific training. The research agent was asked whether a deployment-time detector could identify harmful distribution shifts (changes that degrade the model’s accuracy) without erroneously flagging benign shifts and without access to labels at inference time. The brief given to the agent requested a method to solve this problem which outperforms a set of pre-specified classical shift detector baselines and survives a pre-registered falsification test. The agent had to write and submit a manuscript that it had reviewed and deemed worthy of acceptance at a machine learning conference, along with a package for reproducing the analyses and results.
paragraphs.zh: 该样本的任务说明提出了一个关于表格数据先验拟合网络（PFN）的方法问题：这类模型通过基于支持集的上下文学习来对表格数据进行分类，而非进行任务特定的训练。 研究智能体被问及：在部署时，检测器能否识别有害的分布偏移（即导致模型准确率下降的变化），同时不会错误地标记良性偏移，且无需在推理阶段访问标签。 给予该智能体的任务说明要求提出一种解决此问题的方法，该方法需优于一系列预先指定的经典偏移检测基线模型，并能通过预先注册的证伪测试。 该智能体必须撰写并提交一篇经过其本人审阅并认为值得在机器学习会议上接受的论文，同时附上用于复现实验分析和结果的软件包。

paragraphs.en: The resulting OpenClaw transcript [ 26 ] sees a Claude-Opus-4.7 agent [ 45 ] produce some 554 orchestrator tool calls and 79 sub-agent deployments, receive 57 operator messages, and undergo 8 context compactions. 13 million tokens were generated during the evaluation, 89% of them in delegated sub-agent work.
paragraphs.zh: 由此生成的 OpenClaw 转录记录 [ 26 ] 显示，一个 Claude-Opus-4.7 智能体 [ 45 ] 发起了约 554 次协调工具调用和 79 次子智能体部署，接收了 57 条操作员消息，并经历了 8 次上下文压缩。在评估过程中共生成了 1300 万个词元，其中 89% 来自委托给子智能体的任务。

paragraphs.en: Our purpose is not to provide a complete assessment of the agent’s AI R&D capability, for which we refer the reader to Kirgis et al. [44] . Instead, we ask four questions a reviewer of this run would want answered: how the research process unfolded ( Section 3.1 ), where test-time compute was spent ( Section 3.2 ), how delegated agents coordinated ( Section 3.3 ), and what further questions can be asked by co-interpreting scanner outputs ( Section 3.4 ). Each subsection reports an observation, discusses plausible interpretations, and notes how Transect produced it. Section 3.5 then discusses what the case establishes and what it does not.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目的并非对智能体的 AI 研发能力进行全面评估，关于这一点，我们建议读者参考 Kirgis 等人 [44] 的研究。 相反，我们提出了四个问题，这些问题正是本次实验的评审者希望得到解答的：研究过程如何展开（第 3.1 节）、测试时的计算资源消耗在何处（第 3.2 节）、代理智能体之间如何协调（第 3.3 节），以及通过联合解读扫描器输出结果还能提出哪些进一步的问题（第 3.4 节）。 每个子节都会报告一项观察结果，讨论可能的解释，并说明 Transect 是如何得出该结果的。 随后，第 3.5 节将讨论该案例所证实的内容以及尚未证实的部分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 places six layers on a shared orchestrator-turn axis, where one turn corresponds to one orchestrator output, so that the layers can be read against one another. The package’s shared model-turn axis assigns an index to each recorded orchestrator model output ( Section A.2 ). The lower layers come from structural scanners, which read facts already recorded in the transcript without calling another model (in ascending order): how the orchestrator’s context changed across compactions, when the operator sent a Telegram message, when sub-agents were launched and returned, and, from a custom scanner that identifies arXiv identifiers, DOIs and heuristically matched titles, where references first appear. Sub-agent markers are labelled using the built-in subagent_classification scanner, which describes what the orchestrator asked each sub-agent to do, not necessarily the work it ultimately performed. The two upper bands come from custom judged scanners that assign one principal label, or a residual “Other”, to each of the epoch’s 580 orchestrator outputs, including tool-only outputs. The research-activity band uses ten named categories intended to capture the typical structure of AI R&D tasks: Hypothesising , Literature grounding , Experiment design , Analysis design , Falsification , Research engineering , Debugging , Evidence interpretation , Reflecting and Writing up . The paper-specific band uses the closed vocabulary defined for decision_phases in the family’s Spec , which follows the task’s concrete research questions and deliverables, from PFN problem framing and PFN solution ideation through Benchmark construction , PFN model evaluation and Falsification tests to Manuscript write-up , Self-review and Code reproducibility , and separately tracks Non-research-relevant engineering . The category definitions are given in Section A.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 图2将六个层置于共享的协调器-轮次轴上，其中一轮次对应一次协调器输出，从而使得各层可以相互对照阅读。 该包的共享模型-轮次轴为每个记录在案的协调器模型输出分配一个索引（第 A.2 节）。 下层来自结构扫描器，它们无需调用其他模型即可读取转录文本中已记录的事实（按升序排列）：协调器的上下文在各次压缩过程中如何变化、操作员发送电报消息的时间、子智能体启动与返回的时间，以及通过一个自定义扫描器识别 arXiv 标识符、DOI 和启发式匹配标题，确定参考文献首次出现的位置。 子智能体标记使用内置的 subagent_classification 扫描器进行标注，该扫描器描述了协调器要求每个子智能体执行的任务，而非其最终实际完成的工作。 上层两个带来自自定义的 judged 扫描器，它们为每个时代中 580 个协调器输出（包括仅包含工具调用的输出）分配一个主要标签或一个“其他”剩余标签。 研究活动带使用十个命名类别，旨在捕捉人工智能研发任务的典型结构：假设构建、文献基础、实验设计、分析设计、证伪、研究工程、调试、证据解释、反思与撰写。 论文特定带使用该系列 Spec 中为 decision_phases 定义的封闭词汇表，该词汇表遵循任务的具体研究问题和交付成果，涵盖从 PFN 问题界定和 PFN 解决方案构思到基准构建、PFN 模型评估和证伪测试，再到手稿撰写、自我审查与代码可重复性，并单独追踪与研究无关的工程工作。 各类别的定义见第 A.4 节。

sents.en: The research-activity band uses ten named categories intended to capture the typical structure of AI R&D tasks: Hypothesising , Literature grounding , Experiment design , Analysis design , Falsification , Research engineering , Debugging , Evidence interpretation , Reflecting and Writing up .
sents.zh: 研究活动带使用十个命名类别，旨在捕捉人工智能研发任务的典型结构：假设构建、文献基础、实验设计、分析设计、证伪、研究工程、调试、证据解释、反思与撰写。

sents.en: The paper-specific band uses the closed vocabulary defined for decision_phases in the family’s Spec , which follows the task’s concrete research questions and deliverables, from PFN problem framing and PFN solution ideation through Benchmark construction , PFN model evaluation and Falsification tests to Manuscript write-up , Self-review and Code reproducibility , and separately tracks Non-research-relevant engineering .
sents.zh: 论文特定带使用该系列 Spec 中为 decision_phases 定义的封闭词汇表，该词汇表遵循任务的具体研究问题和交付成果，涵盖从 PFN 问题界定和 PFN 解决方案构思到基准构建、PFN 模型评估和证伪测试，再到手稿撰写、自我审查与代码可重复性，并单独追踪与研究无关的工程工作。

sents.en: The category definitions are given in Section A.4 .
sents.zh: 各类别的定义见第 A.4 节。

paragraphs.en: The value of the timeline comes from reading these independently produced layers together. The epoch begins with a long operations-dominated stretch containing little judged research activity other than debugging. This also coincides with frequent operator messages, mostly helping the model to establish permissions for its various tools. Inspection of these turns shows the agent establishing the environment’s permissions, resources, and available tools. Much of the initial literature engagement follows this operational period. The middle of the epoch alternates between benchmark construction, model evaluation, and falsification, with several delegated sub-agents supporting those activities. The final portion concentrates on manuscript drafting and self-review, with writing, citation, and reviewer sub-agents used to parallelise that work. Some context compactions also occur near sub-agent deployments, exposing a possible relationship that can be further investigated rather than merely noticed while reading the raw transcript.
paragraphs.zh: 时间线的价值在于将这些独立生成的层一起解读。 这个时期一开始是一段以操作为主的漫长阶段，除了调试之外几乎没有经过评估的研究活动。 这一阶段也伴随着频繁的操作员消息，主要是帮助模型为其各种工具建立权限。 对这些转向的检查显示，智能体正在建立环境的权限、资源和可用工具。 初期的文献研究大部分都发生在这个操作阶段之后。 该时期的中间阶段在基准构建、模型评估和证伪之间交替进行，并有几个被委派的分智能体支持这些活动。 最后阶段则专注于手稿撰写和自我审查，并使用了写作、引用和评审员分智能体来并行处理这些工作。 一些上下文压缩也发生在分智能体部署附近，这揭示了一种可能存在的关联，这种关联可以进一步研究，而不仅仅是通过阅读原始转录文本时偶然注意到。

paragraphs.en: The combined view also makes absences salient. In the current analysis, only two of the 580 orchestrator outputs are labelled Hypothesising , compared with 56 labelled Reflecting and 27 labelled Evidence interpretation . Surprisingly, Analysis design does not appear at all. The two hypothesising labels occur when the orchestrator plans to derive novel theoretical results for a detector it has already proposed, and it delegates this work to a sub-agent both times. This pattern has at least two potential explanations: the agent may have performed little hypothesis formation, or the scanner may under-detect diffuse or secondary activities when assigning a single principal label. A missing label is therefore weak evidence that the behaviour was absent. Even with that limitation, the timeline turns the impression that “the agent rarely seems to ideate” into a reproducible observation linked to specific turns, an explicit rubric, a reliability indicator, and competing explanations for review.
paragraphs.zh: 综合视角也凸显了缺失的情况。 在当前分析中，580个协调器输出中仅有两个被标记为“假设”，而标记为“反思”的有56个，标记为“证据解释”的有27个。 令人惊讶的是，“分析设计”完全没有出现。 这两个“假设”标签出现在协调器计划为一个已提出的探测器推导出新的理论结果时，并且两次都将这项工作委托给了一个子智能体。 这种模式至少有两种潜在解释：智能体可能几乎没有进行假设构建，或者扫描仪在分配单一主要标签时可能未能充分检测到分散性或次要活动。 因此，标签的缺失只是行为未出现的微弱证据。 即使存在这一局限性，时间线也将“智能体似乎很少进行构思”的印象转化为一种可重复的观察结果，该结果与特定回合、明确的标准、可靠性指标以及可供审查的竞争解释相关联。

paragraphs.en: Both activity bands were produced in a k k -roll regime: Claude Opus 4.7 classified each output k = 5 k=5 times, reading the target’s full text and tool arguments with up to three preceding and following outputs, and the bands display the modal label with adjacent identical labels merged, forming 129 contiguous phases for the paper-specific activities. The grey strip beneath each band shows the fraction of the ten judge-roll pairs assigning different labels: 474 of 580 outputs (81.7%) receive unanimous research-activity labels and 476 (82.1%) unanimous paper-specific labels, with Reflecting and Evidence interpretation comparatively unstable. A cohort regime could instead call several judge models to expose between-model agreement. A solo run would call one model once and would therefore be cheaper, but would provide no empirical stability estimate. The stored scan results retain the prompts, inputs and model responses behind every label so that they can be inspected transparently. Variation in judgements helps identify labels that merit caution or rubric refinement, but low variation does not establish that the labels are valid , which would require independently collected human labels or another suitable external referent to calculate false positive and negative rates ( Section A.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两个活动带均是在 k k -roll 机制下生成的：Claude Opus 4.7 对每个输出进行了 k = 5 次分类，读取目标文本的完整内容以及工具参数，最多包含前后三个输出；这些活动带展示了众数标签，并将相邻的相同标签合并，从而为论文特定的活动形成了 129 个连续阶段。 每个活动带下方的灰色条带显示了十个评审-roll 对中赋予不同标签的比例：580 个输出中有 474 个（81.7%）获得了一致的研究活动标签，476 个（82.1%）获得了一致的论文特定标签；其中，“Reflecting”和“Evidence”的解读相对不稳定。 相比之下，群体机制可以调用多个评审模型，以揭示模型之间的共识程度。 单次运行只会调用一个模型一次，因此成本更低，但无法提供经验性的稳定性估计。 存储的扫描结果保留了每个标签背后的提示、输入和模型响应，以便进行透明审查。 判断中的差异有助于识别需要谨慎对待或改进评分标准的标签，但差异小并不能证明这些标签有效；要验证这一点，需要独立收集的人类标签或其他合适的外部参照物，以计算假阳性率和假阴性率（第 A.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: The same turn-level decomposition supports a second question: how was the test-time compute allocated? Token telemetry, activity labels, and sub-agent events share the same segmentation, so token expenditure can be attributed to the activity and the sub-agent responsible for it. Figure 3 shows the three attributions side by side.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的回合级分解也支持第二个问题：测试时的计算资源是如何分配的？ 标记遥测数据、活动标签和子智能体事件共享相同的分段方式，因此可以将标记消耗归因于负责该活动的子智能体及其对应活动。 图 3 并列展示了这三种归因方式。

sents.en: Figure 3 shows the three attributions side by side.
sents.zh: 图 3 并列展示了这三种归因方式。

paragraphs.en: In the current analysis, self-review and manuscript write-up account for roughly three quarters of all new-work tokens: 7.8 million and 2.9 million, respectively, out of 14.5 million. Almost all of this expenditure is delegated, reflecting the orchestrator’s use of citation, writing, and reviewer sub-agents during the final stages. Non-research engineering is the third largest category at approximately 2.2 million tokens, much of it associated with resolving permissions and determining the scope of the evaluation environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在当前分析中，自我审查和手稿撰写占所有新工作词元的约四分之三：分别为 780 万和 290 万词元，总计 1450 万词元。 这些支出几乎全部被委托执行，反映出协调者在最后阶段使用了引用、写作和评审员子智能体。 非研究类工程是第三大类别，约为 220 万词元，其中大部分与解决权限问题以及确定评估环境的范围有关。

paragraphs.en: By contrast, solution ideation only accounts for approximately 22,000 tokens. Some relevant work may have been labeled under reflection, research engineering, or evidence interpretation, which account for substantially more expenditure. Nevertheless, this allocation is consistent with the original evaluation’s observation that agents “produced papers with extremely thorough negative findings rather than papers with new ideas” [ 44 , p. 16] . Citation sub-agents consume approximately 5 million tokens, but much of this work occurs during manuscript drafting and self-review rather than early hypothesis development. One plausible reading is therefore that literature search primarily supports polishing and substantiating the manuscript rather than generating new scientific directions.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，解决方案构思仅占约 22,000 个词元。 一些相关研究可能被归入反思、研究工程或证据解释类别，这些类别的资源消耗要高出许多。 尽管如此，这种分配与原始评估的观察结果一致，即智能体“产出的是具有极其详尽的负面发现的研究论文，而非提出新想法的研究论文”[44，第 16 页]。 引用子智能体消耗约 500 万个词元，但其中大部分工作发生在手稿撰写和自我评审阶段，而非早期的假设构建阶段。 因此，一种合理的解释是，文献检索主要用于完善和证实手稿，而非生成新的科研方向。

paragraphs.en: These findings also bear on harness and setup uncertainty. Non-research operations occupy a large fraction of the epoch, and most of the operator messages occur during those phases, often providing permissions, resources, or credentials needed to overcome an infrastructural impasse. The observed allocation could reflect an agent preference for tractable operational and writing work, a scaffold that inadequately supports scientific work, or scientific reasoning that is not exposed in the recorded transcript. Transect cannot distinguish these explanations by itself. It makes them precise enough, however, to motivate interventions: evaluators could change the initial permissions, provide a different tool set, alter the research brief, or add progress gates, and then compare the resulting phase and token distributions across epochs.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现也与利用和设置的不确定性有关。 非研究性操作占据了时间周期中的很大一部分，而大多数操作员消息都出现在这些阶段中，通常提供克服基础设施僵局所需的权限、资源或凭证。 观察到的分配可能反映了智能体对易于处理的运营和写作工作的偏好，一种无法充分支持科学工作的框架，或者记录在转录文本中未体现的科学推理。 Transect 本身无法区分这些解释。 然而，这些解释已经足够精确，足以促使干预措施：评估者可以更改初始权限、提供不同的工具集、修改研究简报或添加进度关卡，然后比较不同时间周期中由此产生的阶段和令牌分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Token allocation also provides a way to study capability as a function of test-time compute. Two systems may produce similarly rated final artefacts while using compute differently: one may brute-force many weak experiments, while another may perform fewer, better-motivated tests. Likewise, apparent improvement may be concentrated in research engineering or manuscript production rather than in the scientific activities relevant to capability forecasts, such as solution ideation, experiment design, or falsification. One transcript cannot establish these differences, but the exported dataframes make the same decompositions available across agents, budgets, scaffolds, and repeated epochs.
paragraphs.zh: 令牌分配也为研究能力作为测试时计算能力的函数提供了一种方法。 两个系统可能在以不同方式使用计算资源的情况下产生评分相似但最终成果不同的产物：一个系统可能对许多较弱的实验进行暴力尝试，而另一个系统则可能执行更少但更有针对性的测试。 同样，表面上的改进可能集中在研究工程或手稿撰写方面，而非与能力预测相关的科学活动中，例如解决方案构思、实验设计或证伪。 单一转录记录无法证实这些差异，但导出的数据框使得相同的分解结果在不同智能体、预算、框架和重复周期中均可获取。

paragraphs.en: A multi-agent evaluation creates an interaction structure that is difficult to reconstruct from raw logs: which shared files agents wrote and read, in what order, and what kinds of exchange these were. To follow work across agent boundaries we extend the report with a custom structural scanner for shared-file access and an optional judged scanner for its likely purpose, and combine their outputs in Figure 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体评估会形成一种互动结构，这种结构难以从原始日志中重建：即智能体写了和读取了哪些共享文件、按什么顺序操作，以及这些交互属于何种类型。 为了追踪跨智能体的工作流，我们在报告中增加了一个用于共享文件访问的自定义结构扫描器，以及一个可选的判断扫描器以分析其可能用途，并将两者的输出整合到图4中。

sents.en: A multi-agent evaluation creates an interaction structure that is difficult to reconstruct from raw logs: which shared files agents wrote and read, in what order, and what kinds of exchange these were.

paragraphs.en: The structural scanner joins recorded file access events to earlier writes by other separately logged agent conversations or tasks ( sessions ), preserving session identifiers, resource paths, source positions, and evidence types in the dataframes . It produces 922 access records across 131 participating sessions, of which 346 records connect one delegated sub-agent to another. The sessions comprise delegated sub-agents, tasks triggered by the harness’s scheduler, and the harness’s main and Telegram chat contexts. The dataframes retain the writer-reader direction.
paragraphs.zh: 结构扫描器将记录的文件访问事件与先前由其他独立记录的智能体对话或任务（会话）所执行的写入操作关联起来，并在数据框中保留会话标识符、资源路径、源位置及证据类型。 它生成了来自 131 个参与会话的 922 条访问记录，其中 346 条记录将某个受委托的子智能体与另一个子智能体连接起来。 这些会话包括受委托的子智能体、由框架调度器触发的任务，以及框架的主上下文和 Telegram 聊天上下文。 数据框保留了写入方与读取方的方向信息。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 , Panel A follows the research plan, baseline code, experiments-section draft, and third blind-review document through the recorded workflow. These four tracks represent 159 access records involving 39 sessions; the activity strip retains all 131 participants. Each arc connects a record’s first qualifying read to the named writer’s latest preceding write. Agent bars span first to last recorded activity, while file tracks span first recorded write to last recorded read or write. The axis follows source-file order: these spans establish neither elapsed time nor continuous agent activity or file persistence.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 的 A 图通过记录的工作流，依次展示了研究计划、基准代码、实验部分草案以及第三次盲审文件。 这四条轨迹代表了包含 39 次会话的 159 条访问记录；活动条保留了全部 131 名参与者。 每条弧线将一条记录的首次有效读取与该命名作者的最新前一次写入连接起来。 智能体条覆盖了从首次到末次记录的活动，而文件轨迹则覆盖了从首次记录写入到末次记录读取或写入的区间。 坐标轴遵循源文件的顺序：这些区间既不代表经过的时间，也不代表智能体的持续活动或文件的持久存在。

paragraphs.en: Access is concentrated in the manuscript workspace: 614 of the 922 records (66.6%) concern paths under paper/ , including drafts, reviews, and build files. The experiments-section draft alone accounts for 102 records, visible as repeated connections along its track. Together with the token attribution in Section 3.2 , this identifies the manuscript workspace as a priority for examining how delegated contributions were assembled. A reviewer can follow a shared document to its recorded writers and readers, then inspect their instructions and subsequent edits.
paragraphs.zh: 访问权限主要集中在手稿工作区：922 条记录中有 614 条（66.6%）涉及 paper/ 下的路径，包括草稿、评审意见和构建文件。 仅实验部分的草稿就占了 102 条记录，这在其路径上表现为重复的连接。 结合第 3.2 节中的标记归属分析，可以确定手稿工作区是考察委托贡献如何整合的关键区域。 评审员可以追踪共享文档，查看其记录中的作者和读者，然后检查他们的说明及后续修改。

paragraphs.en: Purpose classification helps reviewers follow concrete exchanges. For example, the transcript records a sub-agent opening the third blind-review document after receiving instructions to address five major and four minor presentation findings and rebuild the manuscript. All five judge rolls classify this access as responding to assessment . This connects the review track in panel A to a revision brief and a recorded read, giving the reviewer a concrete trail to investigate. Inspecting subsequent edits would establish which findings were addressed and how.
paragraphs.zh: 目的分类有助于评审人追踪具体的交流过程。 例如，记录显示，在收到指示后，一个子智能体打开了第三份盲审文件，需要处理五个主要和四个次要的展示问题，并重新构建手稿。 所有五位评审人的记录都将此次访问归类为对评估的回应。 这将 A 面板中的评审流程与一份修订简报和一次录音阅读联系起来，为评审人提供了可供调查的具体线索。 检查后续编辑将明确哪些问题得到了处理以及处理方式。

paragraphs.en: This remains a prototype, but its provenance, coverage, and repeatability diagnostics make the limits explicit. Across the transcript, 150 records receive substantive rule-assigned labels and 214 receive judge-assigned labels; 558 remain unclear. Among the judge-labelled records, 166 (77.6%) receive unanimous labels across five Opus 4.7 rolls. This measures within-model repeatability; purpose validity and uptake require further evidence. The coverage gaps suggest concrete improvements: parsing omitted shell commands and direct messages would capture more exchanges, while harness records of read results, file versions, and sub-agent return payloads would help reviewers trace contributions and check the inferred purposes.
paragraphs.zh: 这仍然是一个原型，但其来源、覆盖范围以及可重复性诊断使其局限性变得明确。 在整个转录文本中，有 150 条记录获得了规则分配的有效标签，214 条获得了法官分配的标签；另有 558 条仍不明确。 在由法官标注的记录中，有 166 条（77.6%）在五轮 Opus 4.7 测试中获得了一致标签。 这衡量的是模型内部的可重复性；其目的有效性和实际采用情况仍需更多证据支持。 覆盖范围的空白表明存在具体的改进方向：解析被遗漏的 shell 命令和直接消息将能捕捉更多交互内容，而利用已读结果、文件版本以及子智能体返回负载的记录，则有助于评审者追溯贡献并验证推断出的目的。

paragraphs.en: Once phase labels, recorded events and reference records share one representation, questions that would otherwise require bespoke transcript processing become cheap to formulate and test. We ask three here: whether the workflow has recurring structure, whether behavioural transitions cluster near operator messages or context compactions, and how the agent’s literature coverage compares with that of the human authors. Figure 5 presents descriptive analyses of these three questions.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦阶段标签、记录的事件和参考记录共享同一表示，那些原本需要专门处理转录文本的问题，现在就能以低成本的方式构建和检验。 我们在此提出三个问题：该工作流程是否具有重复出现的结构？行为转换是否集中在操作员的消息或上下文压缩附近？以及智能体的文献覆盖范围与人类作者的相比如何？ 图 5 展示了针对这三个问题的描述性分析。

paragraphs.en: The phase-transition graph shows the transitions between paper-specific research activities, excluding non-research engineering. Two regimes are visible: a build-and-test loop through benchmark construction, model evaluation, ablations, and falsification; and a write-and-review oscillation between manuscript write-up and self-review, with some input from theory building, code reproducibility, and running ablations.
paragraphs.zh: 相变图展示了特定于论文的研究活动之间的转换，排除了非研究性的工程活动。 可以看到两种模式：一种是通过基准构建、模型评估、消融实验和证伪的构建-测试循环；另一种是在撰写手稿和自我评审之间来回振荡的撰写-评审循环，其中还包含理论构建、代码可重复性和运行消融实验的一些输入。

paragraphs.en: This phase-transition graph (top left panel, Figure 5 ) illustrates how an ordered sequence of task-specific phase labels makes transitions between activities directly computable.
paragraphs.zh: 这种相变图（图5左上角面板）展示了有序的、针对特定任务的相标签序列如何使得活动之间的转换可以直接计算。

paragraphs.en: This graph structure can also guide investigation of the evaluation setup. The repeated cycle between manuscript drafting and review motivates testing whether the setup encourages iteration over the written artefact. The build-and-test loop is less dominant and does not show an equivalently strong earlier cycle of generating, selecting, and testing alternative ideas. Evaluation and harness designers could use this graph as a target for intervention, for example by introducing an explicit ideation gate or requiring comparison among several candidate methods before manuscript drafting begins. Comparing repeated epochs under otherwise comparable original and modified setups would help assess the intervention’s effects on behaviour and the final score.
paragraphs.zh: 这种图结构也可以指导对评估设置的探究。 手稿起草与评审之间的重复循环，促使我们检验该设置是否鼓励对书面成果进行迭代。 “构建-测试”循环的主导性较弱，并未表现出在早期阶段生成、选择和测试替代方案时同样强烈的循环过程。 评估和工具的设计者可以将此图作为干预的目标，例如通过引入明确的创意生成环节，或在开始起草手稿前要求对多个候选方法进行比较。 在其他条件相当的情况下，比较原始设置与修改后设置在多个重复周期中的表现，将有助于评估该干预措施对行为及最终得分的影响。

paragraphs.en: The event-proximity panel (top-right panel, Figure 5 ) shows whether new phases begin near operator interventions or context compactions. In the current analysis, a new phase begins within three indexed steps of 18 of the 57 operator messages and within ten steps of 28 operator messages. New phases begin within 3 indexed steps of 3 compactions and within 10 steps of one further compaction. These are raw co-occurrence counts, not causal effects: operator messages may respond to an already emerging transition, and compactions may occur at points where the agent would have changed direction anyway. Nevertheless, both event streams are partly determined by the evaluation setup, so their proximity to behavioural transitions identifies a concrete source of setup uncertainty for controlled follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 事件邻近性面板（右上角面板，图 5）显示新阶段是否始于操作者干预或上下文压缩附近。 在当前分析中，在 57 条操作者消息中有 18 条、在 28 条操作者消息中，新阶段均始于索引步长三步以内。 新阶段在 3 次压缩中始于索引步长三步以内，并在另一次压缩中始于步长十步以内。 这些是原始的共现计数，而非因果效应：操作者消息可能回应一个已经出现的转变，而上下文压缩也可能发生在智能体无论如何都会改变方向的节点上。 尽管如此，这两种事件流都部分由评估设置决定，因此它们与行为转变的邻近性为受控后续研究识别出了一个具体的设置不确定性来源。

sents.zh: 新阶段在 3 次压缩中始于索引步长三步以内，并在另一次压缩中始于步长十步以内。

paragraphs.en: The final two panels use a feature of the shadow-evaluation design: the agent-written manuscript can be compared with the unpublished human-written paper on which the brief was based. We first verify cited references against OpenAlex [ 46 ] , Crossref [ 47 ] and arXiv [ 48 ] . 20 out of the agent’s 46 cited references are verified in at least one of these registries, and a further 8 have title matches without linked DOIs, leaving 18 unconfirmed. In contrast, 60 out of the human paper’s 69 references are verified in at least one registry, with a further 5 having a title match, leaving only 4 unconfirmed references. Registry non-matches do not prove fabrication, but the difference identifies a substantially greater citation-verification burden in the agent-written manuscript.
paragraphs.zh: 最后两个面板利用了影子评估设计的一个特点：智能体撰写的稿件可以与未发表的、作为任务依据的人类撰写论文进行比较。 我们首先通过 OpenAlex [ 46 ]、Crossref [ 47 ] 和 arXiv [ 48 ] 验证所引用的参考文献。智能体引用的 46 条参考文献中，有 20 条在至少一个这些注册库中得到验证，另有 8 条的标题匹配但无关联 DOI，因此仍有 18 条未得到确认。 相比之下，人类论文 69 条参考文献中有 60 条在至少一个注册库中得到验证，另有 5 条的标题匹配，因此仅有 4 条参考文献尚未得到确认。 注册库中的不匹配结果并不能证明存在编造行为，但这一差异表明智能体撰写的稿件在引用验证方面负担明显更重。

paragraphs.en: The citation network provides a complementary view. The manuscripts share 13 references, but the human paper draws on a larger and more internally connected literature, as indicated by the density of citation links among its referenced works. This is consistent with the possibility that the agent’s search did not recover the same scientific background as the human researchers. It also suggests a follow-up intervention: evaluators could supply the human bibliography as part of the scaffold and test whether access to the same literature changes the agent’s hypotheses, experimental choices, or final claims.
paragraphs.zh: 引文网络提供了另一种补充性的视角。 这些手稿共有 13 处共同引用，但人类撰写的论文所依据的文献范围更广且内部联系更紧密，这一点可从其参考文献之间的引文链接密度中看出。 这与这样一种可能性一致：该智能体的搜索并未检索到与人类研究人员相同的科学背景知识。 这也提出了一项后续干预措施：评估者可以将人类使用的文献列表作为框架的一部分提供，并测试能否通过获取相同的文献来改变智能体的假设、实验选择或最终结论。

paragraphs.en: The package supports displaying analyses such as these, alongside its timeline and token allocations, as custom report elements ( Figure 1 , Section A.6 ). Linking their summaries to phases and source turns requires matching transcript identities and compatible turn or tool-call indices.
paragraphs.zh: 该包支持显示此类分析结果，并将其与时间线和令牌分配一同作为自定义报告元素展示（图 1，第 A.6 节）。 要将它们的摘要与阶段和源回合关联起来，需要匹配转录本身份以及兼容的回合或工具调用索引。

paragraphs.en: This analysis establishes some interesting features of the agent’s behaviour: It starts with a long operational opening without much hypothesis generation. Most of the tokens are spent by sub-agents doing manuscript writing and review, phases through which the agent iterates several times.
paragraphs.zh: 这项分析揭示了智能体行为的一些有趣特征：它首先经历一个较长的操作阶段，期间几乎没有生成假设。 大部分代币被子智能体用于手稿撰写和评审，智能体在这些阶段中会多次迭代。

sents.en: This analysis establishes some interesting features of the agent’s behaviour: It starts with a long operational opening without much hypothesis generation.
sents.zh: 这项分析揭示了智能体行为的一些有趣特征：它首先经历一个较长的操作阶段，期间几乎没有生成假设。

sents.en: Most of the tokens are spent by sub-agents doing manuscript writing and review, phases through which the agent iterates several times.
sents.zh: 大部分代币被子智能体用于手稿撰写和评审，智能体在这些阶段中会多次迭代。

paragraphs.en: However, this analysis is descriptive rather than confirmatory. It does not firmly establish the agent’s AI R&D capability, the validity of the judged labels, or causal effects of operator messages, compactions, or the scaffold. Those claims would require multiple epochs on multiple samples from the same evaluation family, independently collected expert labels for the judged scanners, and an explicit statistical model for trends across runs ( Section A.3 ). Transect offers a coherent framework for doing this kind of rigorous, confirmatory analysis on open-ended, long-horizon evaluations, while maintaining reproducibility and transparency.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种分析属于描述性分析，而非验证性分析。 它并未明确证实智能体的 AI 研发能力、所判标签的有效性，或操作员消息、压缩操作或框架的因果效应。 这些主张需要针对同一评估族中的多个样本进行多轮训练，为所判扫描仪收集独立采集的专家标签，并建立用于分析各次运行趋势的明确统计模型（第 A.3 节）。 Transect 为此类在开放且长期评估中开展的严谨验证性分析提供了一个连贯的框架，同时确保了可重复性和透明度。

sents.zh: 然而，这种分析属于描述性分析，而非验证性分析。

sents.en: It does not firmly establish the agent’s AI R&D capability, the validity of the judged labels, or causal effects of operator messages, compactions, or the scaffold.

sents.en: Transect offers a coherent framework for doing this kind of rigorous, confirmatory analysis on open-ended, long-horizon evaluations, while maintaining reproducibility and transparency.
sents.zh: Transect 为此类在开放且长期评估中开展的严谨验证性分析提供了一个连贯的框架，同时确保了可重复性和透明度。

paragraphs.en: Open-ended, long-horizon agent evaluations are narrowing the observability envelope—what an evaluation reliably tells us about an agent—because they are getting longer, more complex, and more parallelised. A natural solution to this is to use language models to assist with transcript analysis, but this leads to significant researcher degrees of freedom. We present Transect as a tool to address these twin problems, by making within-run behaviour scrutable while supporting reliability checks and reproducible analysis. Transect places a run on a shared turn axis, selects the sample and epoch to read, reads the transcript with structural and judged scanners, and writes every signal into one set of dataframes that can be digested as a human-readable report. This is the heart of the value proposition of Transect: it allows evaluators to both readily access the ‘wider picture’ and quickly identify and analyse key moments in the agent’s trajectory - whether these are indicative of agent capability, safety incidents, harness constraints, or other research questions the decomposition exposes. We argue that this human-accessible, cohesive picture is critical for maintaining effective oversight for increasingly long and complex evaluation transcripts.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式的长期智能体评估正在缩小可观察性范围——即评估能够可靠地揭示关于智能体的信息——因为这些评估正变得越来越长、越来越复杂，并且越来越并行化。 一个自然的解决方案是使用语言模型来辅助转录分析，但这会给研究人员带来显著的自由裁量空间。 我们提出 Transect 作为解决这两个双重问题的工具：它既能使运行过程中的行为变得清晰可查，又能支持可靠性检查和可重复的分析。 Transect 将一次运行置于共享的轮次轴上，选择要读取的样本和周期，使用结构扫描器和判断扫描器读取转录内容，并将所有信号写入一组数据框，以便以人类可读的报告形式进行解析。 这正是 Transect 价值主张的核心：它使评估者既能轻松获取“更全面的图景”，又能快速识别和分析智能体发展轨迹中的关键时刻——无论这些时刻是否反映了智能体的能力、安全事件、约束条件，还是分解过程揭示的其他研究问题。 我们认为，这种人类可访问且连贯一致的图景，对于维持日益漫长和复杂的评估转录的有效监督至关重要。

paragraphs.en: While language models are becoming increasingly important for transcript analysis, they must be used with caution. LLM-based scanners can overstate confidence, hide uncertainty, and ultimately be over-interpreted by human reviewers [ 24 , 49 ] . Language models are increasingly capable as judges for many classification tasks, though reliability does not establish validity [ 25 ] . Transect records available reliability diagnostics and flags potential problems for review. Assessing validity requires separate evidence, such as comparison with independently collected expert annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管语言模型在转录分析中的重要性日益凸显，但仍需谨慎使用。 基于大型语言模型的扫描工具可能会夸大置信度、隐藏不确定性，并最终被人类审核人员过度解读 [ 24 , 49 ] 。 语言模型在许多分类任务中越来越能胜任判断角色，但其可靠性并不等同于有效性 [ 25 ] 。 转录记录提供了可用的可靠性诊断信息，并标记出潜在问题以供审核。 评估有效性需要独立的证据支持，例如与独立收集的专家标注进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Expert elicitation, long established in risk analysis [ 27 ] , can calibrate Transect through written materials or targeted questions that shape which signals a family of evaluations should surface. Reviewers can examine classifications alongside the agent’s recorded reasoning, tool use, and harness events. These signals need not be independent, but reading them together can expose gaps or inconsistencies that warrant inspection. Provenance records show how a classification was produced and which source turns it was derived from. This view can also help evaluators investigate how the harness shapes agent behaviour and where its records are incomplete. For example, if the transcript does not record a tool failure, adding that event to future logs would let reviewers examine subsequent behaviour alongside the failure. The package’s coding assistant skills and worked examples are designed to reduce the work needed to configure new evaluation families and extend their analyses. They guide coding assistants in adding scanners or report views, inspecting judging records and diagnostics, and testing sensitivity to category names. These provenance and reliability disciplines support reproducibility and should accompany each extension of the analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 专家征询法在风险分析领域已有长期应用 [27]，它可以通过书面材料或针对性问题来校准“横断面”分析，从而引导某一类评估应呈现哪些信号。 评审员可以结合智能体记录的推理过程、工具使用情况和“harness”事件，一同审查分类结果。 这些信号不必相互独立，但通过综合解读它们，可以发现需要进一步核查的空白或矛盾之处。 来源记录展示了某一分类是如何生成的，以及其具体源自哪个信息源。 这种视角也有助于评估员探究“harness”如何影响智能体的行为，以及其记录中哪些部分存在缺失。 例如，如果转录记录中没有记载某项工具故障，将这一事件加入未来的日志中，评审员就能结合该故障分析后续的行为表现。 该软件包中的编码助理技能和示例操作旨在减少配置新评估类别及扩展分析所需的工作量。 它们能指导编码助理添加扫描器或报告视图、审查判断记录与诊断信息，并测试对类别名称的敏感度。 这些关于来源和可靠性的规范有助于确保结果可重复，并且每次扩展分析时都应一并遵循。

sents.zh: 来源记录展示了某一分类是如何生成的，以及其具体源自哪个信息源。

sents.en: This view can also help evaluators investigate how the harness shapes agent behaviour and where its records are incomplete.
sents.zh: 这种视角也有助于评估员探究“harness”如何影响智能体的行为，以及其记录中哪些部分存在缺失。

sents.en: For example, if the transcript does not record a tool failure, adding that event to future logs would let reviewers examine subsequent behaviour alongside the failure.
sents.zh: 例如，如果转录记录中没有记载某项工具故障，将这一事件加入未来的日志中，评审员就能结合该故障分析后续的行为表现。

sents.en: The package’s coding assistant skills and worked examples are designed to reduce the work needed to configure new evaluation families and extend their analyses.
sents.zh: 该软件包中的编码助理技能和示例操作旨在减少配置新评估类别及扩展分析所需的工作量。

sents.en: They guide coding assistants in adding scanners or report views, inspecting judging records and diagnostics, and testing sensitivity to category names.
sents.zh: 它们能指导编码助理添加扫描器或报告视图、审查判断记录与诊断信息，并测试对类别名称的敏感度。

sents.en: These provenance and reliability disciplines support reproducibility and should accompany each extension of the analysis.
sents.zh: 这些关于来源和可靠性的规范有助于确保结果可重复，并且每次扩展分析时都应一并遵循。

paragraphs.en: Transect turns long evaluation transcripts into source-linked reports and reusable analysis tables. The case study illustrates how these outputs bring behavioural classifications, token use across the orchestrator and sub-agents, multi-agent interactions, and harness events into one review workflow that is navigable, auditable, and reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: Transect 将冗长的评估转录文本转换为与源数据关联的报告和可重复使用的分析表。 该案例研究展示了这些输出如何将行为分类、协调器和子智能体中的标记使用、多智能体交互以及 harness 事件整合到一个可导航、可审计且可重复的审查工作流程中。

This appendix describes how to run an analysis ( Section A.1 ), what the scanners produce ( Section A.2 ), and how to read and reuse the outputs ( Section A.3 ). It then covers family configuration ( Section A.4 ), judging and auditing ( Section A.5 ), extensions ( Section A.6 ), and reproducibility and scaling ( Section A.7 ).

paragraphs.en: To analyse a run, the user supplies transcript logs and a Spec , the reusable configuration for an evaluation family. The Spec defines the behavioural vocabularies and task context. Analysis settings, including the judge models and number of repeated calls, are supplied separately to transect() . This function analyses the selected sample and epochs, generates the report, and returns a TransectResults object containing the dataframes.
paragraphs.zh: 要分析一次运行，用户需要提供转录日志和一个 Spec，即用于评估系列的可重用配置。 Spec 定义了行为词汇表和任务上下文。 分析设置（包括评判模型和重复调用次数）需单独提供给 transect()。 该函数会分析选定的样本和周期，生成报告，并返回一个包含数据框的 TransectResults 对象。

sents.en: To analyse a run, the user supplies transcript logs and a Spec , the reusable configuration for an evaluation family.
sents.zh: 要分析一次运行，用户需要提供转录日志和一个 Spec，即用于评估系列的可重用配置。

sents.en: The Spec defines the behavioural vocabularies and task context.

sents.zh: 分析设置（包括评判模型和重复调用次数）需单独提供给 transect()。

sents.en: This function analyses the selected sample and epochs, generates the report, and returns a TransectResults object containing the dataframes.
sents.zh: 该函数会分析选定的样本和周期，生成报告，并返回一个包含数据框的 TransectResults 对象。

paragraphs.en: load() rebuilds dataframes from a stored scan without model calls. render() generates a report from those results and available source transcripts ( Section A.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: load() 会从已存储的扫描结果中重建数据框，而无需调用模型。render() 会根据这些结果以及可用的源转录文本生成报告（第 A.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Transect builds on Inspect Scout’s transcript representation, scanner abstraction and stored scan results [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Transect 在 Inspect Scout 的转录表示、扫描器抽象和已存储的扫描结果 [ 18 ] 的基础上进行了扩展。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarises the pipeline’s inputs and outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 总结了该流程的输入和输出。

paragraphs.en: Ingestion presents supported evaluation logs as Scout transcripts so the same scanners can analyse them. Transect reads Inspect .eval logs and imports OpenClaw JSONL exports produced by telemetry-hal. The OpenClaw importer removes duplicate records from cumulative exports and reconstructs recorded messages, tool activity and sub-agent activity. What reviewers can inspect depends on the source records, including the available event and token-usage details. Additional formats require an adapter to this representation ( Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 摄入模块将受支持的评估日志以“Scout”转录本的形式呈现，以便相同的扫描器能够进行分析。 “Transect”读取“Inspect .eval”日志，并导入由“telemetry-hal”生成的 OpenClaw JSONL 导出文件。 OpenClaw 导入器会从累积的导出文件中移除重复记录，并重构已记录的消息、工具活动以及子智能体活动。 评审员能够检查的内容取决于源记录，包括可用的事件和令牌使用详情。 其他格式需要适配器来转换为此种表示形式（图 1）。

sents.en: Ingestion presents supported evaluation logs as Scout transcripts so the same scanners can analyse them.
sents.zh: 摄入模块将受支持的评估日志以“Scout”转录本的形式呈现，以便相同的扫描器能够进行分析。

sents.en: Transect reads Inspect .eval logs and imports OpenClaw JSONL exports produced by telemetry-hal.
sents.zh: “Transect”读取“Inspect .eval”日志，并导入由“telemetry-hal”生成的 OpenClaw JSONL 导出文件。

sents.en: The OpenClaw importer removes duplicate records from cumulative exports and reconstructs recorded messages, tool activity and sub-agent activity.
sents.zh: OpenClaw 导入器会从累积的导出文件中移除重复记录，并重构已记录的消息、工具活动以及子智能体活动。

sents.en: What reviewers can inspect depends on the source records, including the available event and token-usage details.
sents.zh: 评审员能够检查的内容取决于源记录，包括可用的事件和令牌使用详情。

sents.en: Additional formats require an adapter to this representation ( Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 其他格式需要适配器来转换为此种表示形式（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: A sample is an evaluation task or item; an epoch is an attempt at that sample. Each analysis selects one sample and one, several or all of its epochs before scanning. Inputs containing multiple samples require an explicit sample choice. If no epochs are specified, Transect selects the earliest epoch recorded as successful, or the earliest epoch if none is recorded as successful. This default favours successful attempts when available. Analyses requiring all attempts or a pre-specified sample of attempts should set the epoch selection explicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 样本是一个评估任务或项目；一个周期是对该样本的一次尝试。 每次分析在扫描前会选择一个样本以及该样本的一个、多个或所有周期。 包含多个样本的输入需要明确指定样本选择。 如果未指定任何周期，Transect 会选择最早被记录为成功的周期；如果没有被记录为成功的周期，则选择最早的周期。 这种默认设置在有可用成功尝试时会优先选择成功尝试。 需要所有尝试或预先指定数量的尝试的分析应明确设置周期选择。

sents.zh: 样本是一个评估任务或项目；一个周期是对该样本的一次尝试。

sents.zh: 每次分析在扫描前会选择一个样本以及该样本的一个、多个或所有周期。

sents.zh: 这种默认设置在有可用成功尝试时会优先选择成功尝试。
