sents.zh: 这些是对已存储审核记录的摘要，并不一定涵盖所有尝试过的审核。

paragraphs.en: Read these rates with the selection and record-coverage limits above. A low change rate can reflect agreement with the initial labels or proposed changes below the confidence threshold for application; it does not establish a low error rate.
paragraphs.zh: 请结合上述选择项和记录覆盖范围，阅读这些比率。 较低的变化率可能反映对初始标签的认同，或表明所提变更低于应用所需的置信度阈值；但这并不意味着错误率低。

sents.en: Read these rates with the selection and record-coverage limits above.
sents.zh: 请结合上述选择项和记录覆盖范围，阅读这些比率。

sents.en: A low change rate can reflect agreement with the initial labels or proposed changes below the confidence threshold for application; it does not establish a low error rate.
sents.zh: 较低的变化率可能反映对初始标签的认同，或表明所提变更低于应用所需的置信度阈值；但这并不意味着错误率低。

paragraphs.en: For counted proportions, including member coverage and verifier-change rates, the package uses nominal 95% Wilson intervals and returns no rate or interval when the denominator is zero. For audit summaries of mean confidence or agreement, it drops missing values and uses the normal approximation x ¯ ± 1.96 ​ s / n \bar{x}\pm 1.96s/\sqrt{n} , where s s is the sample standard deviation and n n is the number of retained values. These audit mean intervals are omitted below eight values.
paragraphs.zh: 对于已计数的比例（包括成员覆盖率和验证器变更率），该包使用名义上的 95% Wilson 置信区间，并在分母为零时不返回任何比率或区间。 对于均值置信度或一致性的审计摘要，它会剔除缺失值，并使用正态近似公式 x ¯ ± 1.96 ​ s / n \bar{x}\pm 1.96s/\sqrt{n}，其中 s 是样本标准差，n 是保留值的数量。 当数值少于八个时，这些审计均值区间将被省略。

sents.en: For counted proportions, including member coverage and verifier-change rates, the package uses nominal 95% Wilson intervals and returns no rate or interval when the denominator is zero.
sents.zh: 对于已计数的比例（包括成员覆盖率和验证器变更率），该包使用名义上的 95% Wilson 置信区间，并在分母为零时不返回任何比率或区间。

sents.en: For audit summaries of mean confidence or agreement, it drops missing values and uses the normal approximation x ¯ ± 1.96 ​ s / n \bar{x}\pm 1.96s/\sqrt{n} , where s s is the sample standard deviation and n n is the number of retained values.
sents.zh: 对于均值置信度或一致性的审计摘要，它会剔除缺失值，并使用正态近似公式 x ¯ ± 1.96 ​ s / n \bar{x}\pm 1.96s/\sqrt{n}，其中 s 是样本标准差，n 是保留值的数量。

sents.en: These audit mean intervals are omitted below eight values.
sents.zh: 当数值少于八个时，这些审计均值区间将被省略。

paragraphs.en: These calculations do not account for dependence between turns, shared judge errors or the verifier’s selection process. Their nominal level therefore does not guarantee 95% coverage for a claim about a run or evaluation family. An interval around mean stated confidence describes those confidence values; it does not turn them into calibrated probabilities of correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 这些计算没有考虑各轮次之间的依赖关系、共同存在的评判错误，或验证器的选择过程。 因此，其标称水平并不能保证对某个运行实例或评估族的主张具有 95% 的覆盖度。 围绕所声明平均置信度的区间描述了这些置信值；但它并不会将这些置信值转化为经过校准的正确性概率。

sents.en: These calculations do not account for dependence between turns, shared judge errors or the verifier’s selection process.
sents.zh: 这些计算没有考虑各轮次之间的依赖关系、共同存在的评判错误，或验证器的选择过程。

sents.en: Their nominal level therefore does not guarantee 95% coverage for a claim about a run or evaluation family.
sents.zh: 因此，其标称水平并不能保证对某个运行实例或评估族的主张具有 95% 的覆盖度。

sents.en: An interval around mean stated confidence describes those confidence values; it does not turn them into calibrated probabilities of correctness.
sents.zh: 围绕所声明平均置信度的区间描述了这些置信值；但它并不会将这些置信值转化为经过校准的正确性概率。

paragraphs.en: Scanner outputs also contain confidence summaries calculated over different sets of values. A vote’s confidence_pm applies the normal-approximation half-width 1.96 ​ s / n 1.96s/\sqrt{n} to the available stated confidences of members supporting its selected label. The helper returns zero when fewer than two values are available. This differs from the audit mean interval, which is omitted below eight values.
paragraphs.zh: 扫描器的输出还包含基于不同值集合计算出的置信度摘要。 投票的 confidence_pm 将正态近似半宽度 1.96 ​ s / n 1.96s/\sqrt{n} 应用于支持其选定标签的成员所声明的可用置信度。 当可用值少于两个时，辅助函数返回零。 这与审计均值区间不同，后者在值少于八个时会被省略。

sents.en: Scanner outputs also contain confidence summaries calculated over different sets of values.
sents.zh: 扫描器的输出还包含基于不同值集合计算出的置信度摘要。

sents.en: A vote’s confidence_pm applies the normal-approximation half-width 1.96 ​ s / n 1.96s/\sqrt{n} to the available stated confidences of members supporting its selected label.
sents.zh: 投票的 confidence_pm 将正态近似半宽度 1.96 ​ s / n 1.96s/\sqrt{n} 应用于支持其选定标签的成员所声明的可用置信度。

sents.en: The helper returns zero when fewer than two values are available.
sents.zh: 当可用值少于两个时，辅助函数返回零。

sents.en: This differs from the audit mean interval, which is omitted below eight values.
sents.zh: 这与审计均值区间不同，后者在值少于八个时会被省略。

paragraphs.en: For phases, confidence averages the confidence values of the phase’s judged or filled digest turns, treating a missing value as zero. confidence_spread applies the same half-width helper to those turn values. This is a half-width for their mean, not their standard deviation or a measure of disagreement between judges. After an applied verifier change, affected turns receive the verifier’s confidence, and the resulting verifier-marked phase has its spread set to zero. A zero spread can therefore reflect insufficient values or assignment after verifier review, as well as identical confidence values; it is not evidence of certainty.
paragraphs.zh: 对于阶段而言，confidence 会平均该阶段中已判断或已填充的摘要回合的置信值，并将缺失值视为零。confidence_spread 则对这些回合值应用相同的半宽辅助函数。 这是对其均值的一半宽度，而非标准差或裁判之间分歧程度的衡量。 在应用验证器变更之后，受影响的回合将获得验证器的置信值，而由此产生的经验证器标记的阶段其 spread 将被设为零。 因此，零 spread 可能反映验证器审查后数值不足或分配问题，也可能表示置信值完全相同；它并非确定性的证据。

sents.en: For phases, confidence averages the confidence values of the phase’s judged or filled digest turns, treating a missing value as zero. confidence_spread applies the same half-width helper to those turn values.
sents.zh: 对于阶段而言，confidence 会平均该阶段中已判断或已填充的摘要回合的置信值，并将缺失值视为零。confidence_spread 则对这些回合值应用相同的半宽辅助函数。

sents.en: This is a half-width for their mean, not their standard deviation or a measure of disagreement between judges.
sents.zh: 这是对其均值的一半宽度，而非标准差或裁判之间分歧程度的衡量。

sents.en: After an applied verifier change, affected turns receive the verifier’s confidence, and the resulting verifier-marked phase has its spread set to zero.
sents.zh: 在应用验证器变更之后，受影响的回合将获得验证器的置信值，而由此产生的经验证器标记的阶段其 spread 将被设为零。

sents.en: A zero spread can therefore reflect insufficient values or assignment after verifier review, as well as identical confidence values; it is not evidence of certainty.
sents.zh: 因此，零 spread 可能反映验证器审查后数值不足或分配问题，也可能表示置信值完全相同；它并非确定性的证据。

paragraphs.en: The current report uses fixed rules to flag diagnostics for inspection:
paragraphs.zh: 当前报告使用固定规则来标记待检查的诊断信息：

paragraphs.en: Mean k k -roll vote agreement below 0.80 or above 0.95 produces an amber warning.
paragraphs.zh: 当平均 k k -roll 投票一致性低于 0.80 或高于 0.95 时，将触发琥珀色警告。

paragraphs.en: Cohort Krippendorff’s α \alpha below 0.66 produces a red warning; values from 0.66 up to, but not including, 0.80 produce an amber warning.
paragraphs.zh: 群体克里普登多夫 α \alpha 值低于 0.66 时会显示红色警告；从 0.66 到（但不包括）0.80 的数值则会显示琥珀色警告。

paragraphs.en: Overall or per-label verifier-change rates of at least 0.20 produce an amber warning.
paragraphs.zh: 整体或每个标签的验证器变更率至少达到 0.20 时，会触发琥珀色警告。

paragraphs.en: Any applied change in the recorded spot-check subset produces a red warning.
paragraphs.zh: 对已记录的抽查子集进行的任何应用更改都会触发红色警告。

paragraphs.en: Where a judging regime is recorded, missing classifications produce an amber warning when their share is above zero but below 25%, and a red warning at 25% or more. For phases, this share counts refusal , no_answer and missing_turn rows among all non-attributed phase-turn rows; filled turns enter the denominator only. For sub-agent classification, it counts rows without a label among all recorded classification rows in the sub-agents table, including structurally recorded spans with no classification result.
paragraphs.zh: 在记录有评判机制的情况下，若缺失分类项的比例高于零但低于25%，则会触发琥珀色警告；若达到或超过25%，则会触发红色警告。 对于阶段而言，该比例将拒绝、无答案和缺失回合的行数计入所有未归类的阶段回合行中；仅已填写的回合会进入分母计算。 对于子智能体分类，该比例将子智能体表格中所有记录的分类行里缺少标签的行数计入其中，包括结构上记录但无分类结果的部分。

sents.en: Where a judging regime is recorded, missing classifications produce an amber warning when their share is above zero but below 25%, and a red warning at 25% or more.
sents.zh: 在记录有评判机制的情况下，若缺失分类项的比例高于零但低于25%，则会触发琥珀色警告；若达到或超过25%，则会触发红色警告。

sents.en: For phases, this share counts refusal , no_answer and missing_turn rows among all non-attributed phase-turn rows; filled turns enter the denominator only.
sents.zh: 对于阶段而言，该比例将拒绝、无答案和缺失回合的行数计入所有未归类的阶段回合行中；仅已填写的回合会进入分母计算。

sents.en: For sub-agent classification, it counts rows without a label among all recorded classification rows in the sub-agents table, including structurally recorded spans with no classification result.
sents.zh: 对于子智能体分类，该比例将子智能体表格中所有记录的分类行里缺少标签的行数计入其中，包括结构上记录但无分类结果的部分。

paragraphs.en: These rules apply where the required metrics are available. The report also groups stated confidence into low (below 0.66), medium (0.66 to below 0.80) and high (at least 0.80) bands. These are display conventions, not calibrated levels of correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 当所需指标可用时，这些规则适用。 该报告还将声明的置信度分为低（低于 0.66）、中（0.66 至低于 0.80）和高（至少 0.80）三个区间。 这些是显示惯例，而非经过校准的正确性等级。

sents.en: These rules apply where the required metrics are available.
sents.zh: 当所需指标可用时，这些规则适用。

sents.en: The report also groups stated confidence into low (below 0.66), medium (0.66 to below 0.80) and high (at least 0.80) bands.
sents.zh: 该报告还将声明的置信度分为低（低于 0.66）、中（0.66 至低于 0.80）和高（至少 0.80）三个区间。

sents.en: These are display conventions, not calibrated levels of correctness.
sents.zh: 这些是显示惯例，而非经过校准的正确性等级。

paragraphs.en: Threshold crossings direct attention to the audit and source records. High self-agreement does not by itself diagnose label-name bias, and a spot-check label change does not prove that the original judgement was wrong. Conversely, the absence of a warning does not establish that the classifications are reliable or valid.
paragraphs.zh: 阈值跨越将注意力引向审计和源记录。 高自我一致性本身并不能诊断标签名称偏差，而一次抽查的标签变更也不能证明最初的判断是错误的。 反之，没有警告并不意味着这些分类是可靠或有效的。

sents.en: Threshold crossings direct attention to the audit and source records.
sents.zh: 阈值跨越将注意力引向审计和源记录。

sents.en: High self-agreement does not by itself diagnose label-name bias, and a spot-check label change does not prove that the original judgement was wrong.
sents.zh: 高自我一致性本身并不能诊断标签名称偏差，而一次抽查的标签变更也不能证明最初的判断是错误的。

sents.en: Conversely, the absence of a warning does not establish that the classifications are reliable or valid.
sents.zh: 反之，没有警告并不意味着这些分类是可靠或有效的。

paragraphs.en: Software tests can establish whether a scanner extracts or processes information as specified on the tested inputs. Repeated judgements and cross-model comparisons assess consistency. Neither establishes that a behavioural category captures the intended construct or that its labels are correctly applied to new transcripts.
paragraphs.zh: 软件测试可以确定扫描仪是否按照测试输入中指定的方式提取或处理信息。 重复的判断和跨模型比较能够评估一致性。 这两者都无法确定行为类别是否捕捉到了预期的构念，或其标签是否正确应用于新的转录文本。

sents.en: Software tests can establish whether a scanner extracts or processes information as specified on the tested inputs.
sents.zh: 软件测试可以确定扫描仪是否按照测试输入中指定的方式提取或处理信息。

sents.en: Repeated judgements and cross-model comparisons assess consistency.
sents.zh: 重复的判断和跨模型比较能够评估一致性。

sents.en: Neither establishes that a behavioural category captures the intended construct or that its labels are correctly applied to new transcripts.
sents.zh: 这两者都无法确定行为类别是否捕捉到了预期的构念，或其标签是否正确应用于新的转录文本。

paragraphs.en: External assessment compares classifications with an appropriate reference, such as independently collected expert annotations. Its interpretation depends on the reference’s quality, the assessment procedure and the transcripts represented. Expert review of category definitions is useful for developing a rubric, but is distinct from assessing how judges apply it. A comparison with another model provides additional model evidence; it does not become ground truth merely because that model is different or more capable.
paragraphs.zh: 外部评估会将分类结果与适当的参考标准进行比较，例如独立收集的专家标注。 其解释取决于参考标准的质量、评估流程以及所代表的转录文本。 对类别定义的专家审查有助于制定评分标准，但这与评估裁判如何应用该标准是两回事。 与另一模型进行比较可提供额外的模型证据；仅因该模型不同或能力更强，这种比较并不会成为基准事实。

sents.en: External assessment compares classifications with an appropriate reference, such as independently collected expert annotations.
sents.zh: 外部评估会将分类结果与适当的参考标准进行比较，例如独立收集的专家标注。

sents.en: Its interpretation depends on the reference’s quality, the assessment procedure and the transcripts represented.
sents.zh: 其解释取决于参考标准的质量、评估流程以及所代表的转录文本。

sents.en: Expert review of category definitions is useful for developing a rubric, but is distinct from assessing how judges apply it.
sents.zh: 对类别定义的专家审查有助于制定评分标准，但这与评估裁判如何应用该标准是两回事。

sents.en: A comparison with another model provides additional model evidence; it does not become ground truth merely because that model is different or more capable.
sents.zh: 与另一模型进行比较可提供额外的模型证据；仅因该模型不同或能力更强，这种比较并不会成为基准事实。

paragraphs.en: The scramble_spec helper creates a copy of a Spec with neutral identifiers substituted for its phase and sub-agent labels. It returns a mapping for each classification type that descramble uses to translate output labels back to the original names. Descriptions, task context and operational-category flags are preserved. The helper does not rewrite label names mentioned inside those descriptions or the context, and it does not rename custom vocabularies in Spec.extra . Check which category names and definitions the judge actually receives, including reserved categories, before interpreting a comparison.
paragraphs.zh: scramble_spec 辅助函数会创建一个 Spec 的副本，其中其阶段和子智能体标签会被中立的标识符替换。 它会返回一个针对每种分类类型的映射，用于让 descramble 将输出标签翻译回原始名称。 描述、任务上下文和操作类别标志都会被保留。 该辅助函数不会重写这些描述或上下文中提到的标签名称，也不会重命名 Spec.extra 中的自定义词汇表。 在解释比较结果之前，请检查裁判实际接收到的类别名称和定义，包括保留类别。

sents.en: The scramble_spec helper creates a copy of a Spec with neutral identifiers substituted for its phase and sub-agent labels.
sents.zh: scramble_spec 辅助函数会创建一个 Spec 的副本，其中其阶段和子智能体标签会被中立的标识符替换。

sents.en: It returns a mapping for each classification type that descramble uses to translate output labels back to the original names.
sents.zh: 它会返回一个针对每种分类类型的映射，用于让 descramble 将输出标签翻译回原始名称。

sents.en: Descriptions, task context and operational-category flags are preserved.
sents.zh: 描述、任务上下文和操作类别标志都会被保留。

sents.en: The helper does not rewrite label names mentioned inside those descriptions or the context, and it does not rename custom vocabularies in Spec.extra .
sents.zh: 该辅助函数不会重写这些描述或上下文中提到的标签名称，也不会重命名 Spec.extra 中的自定义词汇表。

sents.en: Check which category names and definitions the judge actually receives, including reserved categories, before interpreting a comparison.
sents.zh: 在解释比较结果之前，请检查裁判实际接收到的类别名称和定义，包括保留类别。

paragraphs.en: Users run the original and renamed configurations on the same inputs and judging settings, then compare outputs for the same turns or sub-agent spans after translating the labels back. Repeated unchanged runs help distinguish sensitivity to names from ordinary judging variation; cached responses cannot provide fresh evidence of that variation. Differences can motivate closer inspection of label wording or rubric definitions, but do not by themselves establish undue reliance on category names. Stability under renaming does not establish classification accuracy. Renamed runs are diagnostic artefacts and should be clearly identified as such; the package does not automatically mark their reports.
paragraphs.zh: 用户在相同的输入和评判设置下运行原始配置和重命名后的配置，然后将标签翻译回原样后，比较相同轮次或子智能体片段中的输出。 重复运行未修改的配置有助于区分名称敏感性与普通评判差异；缓存的响应无法提供这种差异的新证据。 差异可能促使更仔细地检查标签措辞或评分标准定义，但本身并不能证明对类别名称存在不当依赖。 在重命名情况下保持稳定，并不等同于分类准确。 重命名后的运行属于诊断性产物，应明确标识为此类产物；该软件包不会自动标记其报告。

sents.en: Users run the original and renamed configurations on the same inputs and judging settings, then compare outputs for the same turns or sub-agent spans after translating the labels back.
sents.zh: 用户在相同的输入和评判设置下运行原始配置和重命名后的配置，然后将标签翻译回原样后，比较相同轮次或子智能体片段中的输出。

sents.en: Repeated unchanged runs help distinguish sensitivity to names from ordinary judging variation; cached responses cannot provide fresh evidence of that variation.
sents.zh: 重复运行未修改的配置有助于区分名称敏感性与普通评判差异；缓存的响应无法提供这种差异的新证据。

sents.en: Differences can motivate closer inspection of label wording or rubric definitions, but do not by themselves establish undue reliance on category names.
sents.zh: 差异可能促使更仔细地检查标签措辞或评分标准定义，但本身并不能证明对类别名称存在不当依赖。

sents.en: Stability under renaming does not establish classification accuracy.
sents.zh: 在重命名情况下保持稳定，并不等同于分类准确。

sents.en: Renamed runs are diagnostic artefacts and should be clearly identified as such; the package does not automatically mark their reports.
sents.zh: 重命名后的运行属于诊断性产物，应明确标识为此类产物；该软件包不会自动标记其报告。

paragraphs.en: An ablation removes a specified part of an analysis to test what depends on it. For example, removing an expert-supplied contextual instruction while retaining the transcript, category definitions and other analysis settings asks how much the classifications depend on that instruction. Before running the comparison, state what change is expected and which output will be compared. Keep other relevant conditions matched and compare the difference with variation under an unchanged configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 消融法通过移除分析中的某个特定部分，来测试哪些内容依赖于该部分。 例如，在保留转录文本、类别定义和其他分析设置的同时，移除由专家提供的上下文指令，可以检验分类结果在多大程度上依赖于该指令。 在执行比较之前，请说明预期的变化以及将比较哪些输出结果。 保持其他相关条件一致，并与未更改配置下的差异进行比较。

sents.en: An ablation removes a specified part of an analysis to test what depends on it.
sents.zh: 消融法通过移除分析中的某个特定部分，来测试哪些内容依赖于该部分。

sents.en: For example, removing an expert-supplied contextual instruction while retaining the transcript, category definitions and other analysis settings asks how much the classifications depend on that instruction.
sents.zh: 例如，在保留转录文本、类别定义和其他分析设置的同时，移除由专家提供的上下文指令，可以检验分类结果在多大程度上依赖于该指令。

sents.en: Before running the comparison, state what change is expected and which output will be compared.
sents.zh: 在执行比较之前，请说明预期的变化以及将比较哪些输出结果。

sents.en: Keep other relevant conditions matched and compare the difference with variation under an unchanged configuration.
sents.zh: 保持其他相关条件一致，并与未更改配置下的差异进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Check that the intended change reached the configuration or prompt actually used by the analysis. Compare outputs for matching source units, such as turns or sub-agent spans. Report failures and missing coverage in each condition alongside differences between conditions for matched units with usable outputs in both.
paragraphs.zh: 确认预期的变更是否实际作用于分析中使用的配置或提示。 对比匹配源单元（例如回合或子智能体片段）的输出结果。 报告每个条件下的失败情况和覆盖缺失问题，并说明在两个条件下均有可用输出的匹配单元之间的差异。

sents.en: Check that the intended change reached the configuration or prompt actually used by the analysis.
sents.zh: 确认预期的变更是否实际作用于分析中使用的配置或提示。

sents.en: Compare outputs for matching source units, such as turns or sub-agent spans.
sents.zh: 对比匹配源单元（例如回合或子智能体片段）的输出结果。

sents.en: Report failures and missing coverage in each condition alongside differences between conditions for matched units with usable outputs in both.
sents.zh: 报告每个条件下的失败情况和覆盖缺失问题，并说明在两个条件下均有可用输出的匹配单元之间的差异。

paragraphs.en: Removing a category also changes the available answers, so a resulting label change cannot be attributed solely to the removed category’s usefulness. Removing a report layer addresses a different question: its contribution to human review requires an appropriate reviewer study. Perturbations that disrupt transcript information or ordering likewise need an explicit prediction; preserving or losing a signal is not automatically the desirable outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 删除一个类别也会改变可用的答案，因此由此导致的标签变化不能仅仅归因于被删除类别的有用性。 删除报告层则涉及另一个问题：它对人工审核的贡献需要适当的审核员研究来评估。 那些破坏转录信息或顺序的扰动同样需要明确的预测；保留或丢失某种信号并不自动意味着这是理想的结果。

sents.en: Removing a category also changes the available answers, so a resulting label change cannot be attributed solely to the removed category’s usefulness.
sents.zh: 删除一个类别也会改变可用的答案，因此由此导致的标签变化不能仅仅归因于被删除类别的有用性。

sents.en: Removing a report layer addresses a different question: its contribution to human review requires an appropriate reviewer study.
sents.zh: 删除报告层则涉及另一个问题：它对人工审核的贡献需要适当的审核员研究来评估。

sents.en: Perturbations that disrupt transcript information or ordering likewise need an explicit prediction; preserving or losing a signal is not automatically the desirable outcome.
sents.zh: 那些破坏转录信息或顺序的扰动同样需要明确的预测；保留或丢失某种信号并不自动意味着这是理想的结果。

paragraphs.en: These are user-designed comparisons, supported by configurable inputs and stored outputs. The package does not provide a general ablation runner or automatically validate custom scanners through perturbation tests. Any claim that one configuration is more accurate needs an appropriate external assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是用户设计的比较，由可配置输入和存储输出提供支持。 该包不提供通用的消融测试运行器，也不会通过扰动测试自动验证自定义扫描器。 任何声称某种配置更准确的说法都需要适当的外部评估。

sents.en: These are user-designed comparisons, supported by configurable inputs and stored outputs.
sents.zh: 这些是用户设计的比较，由可配置输入和存储输出提供支持。

sents.en: The package does not provide a general ablation runner or automatically validate custom scanners through perturbation tests.
sents.zh: 该包不提供通用的消融测试运行器，也不会通过扰动测试自动验证自定义扫描器。

sents.en: Any claim that one configuration is more accurate needs an appropriate external assessment.
sents.zh: 任何声称某种配置更准确的说法都需要适当的外部评估。

paragraphs.en: The case study illustrates how the combined report supports investigation of an agent’s research process. It does not provide a controlled estimate of reviewer time saved, findings missed or improvements in review decisions. Nor does it isolate the contribution of behavioural classification from that of making a long transcript navigable. Claims about classification accuracy or reviewer benefit require evidence tied to the relevant rubric, package version and evaluation setting.
paragraphs.zh: 该案例研究说明了综合报告如何支持对智能体研究过程的调查。 它并未提供关于评审员节省时间、遗漏的发现或评审决策改进的受控估算。 它也没有将行为分类的贡献与使冗长转录本易于导航的贡献区分开来。 有关分类准确性或评审员益处的说法，需要与相关评分标准、软件包版本和评估设置相关的证据支持。

sents.en: The case study illustrates how the combined report supports investigation of an agent’s research process.
sents.zh: 该案例研究说明了综合报告如何支持对智能体研究过程的调查。

sents.en: It does not provide a controlled estimate of reviewer time saved, findings missed or improvements in review decisions.
sents.zh: 它并未提供关于评审员节省时间、遗漏的发现或评审决策改进的受控估算。

sents.en: Nor does it isolate the contribution of behavioural classification from that of making a long transcript navigable.
sents.zh: 它也没有将行为分类的贡献与使冗长转录本易于导航的贡献区分开来。

sents.en: Claims about classification accuracy or reviewer benefit require evidence tied to the relevant rubric, package version and evaluation setting.
sents.zh: 有关分类准确性或评审员益处的说法，需要与相关评分标准、软件包版本和评估设置相关的证据支持。

paragraphs.en: Users should document what their categories are intended to represent, what assessment has been performed, the reference and data used, and the conditions to which the evidence applies. Distinguish expert review of category definitions from assessment of their application, and state when evidence is absent, preliminary or limited in scope. The package does not maintain a dedicated validation-status record; users must retain this documentation separately. Recording a status does not establish validity.
paragraphs.zh: 用户应记录其分类旨在代表的内容、已执行哪些评估、所使用的参考依据和数据，以及证据适用的条件。 需将分类定义的专家审查与其应用情况的评估区分开来，并在证据缺失、初步或范围有限时予以说明。 该软件包不维护专门的验证状态记录；用户必须单独保存这些文档。 记录状态并不等同于确立有效性。

sents.en: Users should document what their categories are intended to represent, what assessment has been performed, the reference and data used, and the conditions to which the evidence applies.
sents.zh: 用户应记录其分类旨在代表的内容、已执行哪些评估、所使用的参考依据和数据，以及证据适用的条件。

sents.en: Distinguish expert review of category definitions from assessment of their application, and state when evidence is absent, preliminary or limited in scope.
sents.zh: 需将分类定义的专家审查与其应用情况的评估区分开来，并在证据缺失、初步或范围有限时予以说明。

sents.zh: 该软件包不维护专门的验证状态记录；用户必须单独保存这些文档。

sents.en: Recording a status does not establish validity.
sents.zh: 记录状态并不等同于确立有效性。

paragraphs.en: Custom scanner outputs can be converted into dataframes for further analysis or use in timeline layers and other report elements. Users can also model or analyse the dataframes generated by Transect and incorporate the resulting figures or other outputs as custom report elements. Users pass Layer objects through extra_layers . A layer can specify a scanner and a function that builds its dataframe, or accept an existing dataframe. It can also define report elements and phase-card tags. A custom report element therefore need not introduce another scanner. Custom tables are available through results.layer_frames , keyed by layer name. The returned dataframes also support separate dashboards, figures or summaries.
paragraphs.zh: 自定义扫描器输出可以转换为数据框，用于进一步分析或用于时间线层和其他报告元素。 用户还可以对 Transect 生成的数据框进行建模或分析，并将生成的图表或其他输出作为自定义报告元素纳入其中。 用户通过 extra_layers 传递 Layer 对象。 一个层可以指定一个扫描器和一个用于构建其数据框的函数，或者接受一个现有的数据框。 它还可以定义报告元素和阶段卡标签。 因此，自定义报告元素无需引入另一个扫描器。 通过 results.layer_frames 可以访问自定义表格，其键为层名称。 返回的数据框还支持独立的仪表板、图表或摘要。

sents.zh: 自定义扫描器输出可以转换为数据框，用于进一步分析或用于时间线层和其他报告元素。

sents.zh: 用户通过 extra_layers 传递 Layer 对象。

sents.zh: 一个层可以指定一个扫描器和一个用于构建其数据框的函数，或者接受一个现有的数据框。

sents.en: It can also define report elements and phase-card tags.
sents.zh: 它还可以定义报告元素和阶段卡标签。

sents.en: A custom report element therefore need not introduce another scanner.
sents.zh: 因此，自定义报告元素无需引入另一个扫描器。

sents.zh: 通过 results.layer_frames 可以访问自定义表格，其键为层名称。

sents.en: The returned dataframes also support separate dashboards, figures or summaries.
sents.zh: 返回的数据框还支持独立的仪表板、图表或摘要。

paragraphs.en: Custom scanners can extract structural information or ask judge models to classify behaviour. For example, a structural scanner might identify recorded test failures, while a judged scanner might classify research activities using a family-specific rubric. Each scanner is registered with Scout’s @scanner decorator and supplied through a layer. Its results are saved in the Scout scan store and can be converted into a custom dataframe.
paragraphs.zh: 自定义扫描器可以提取结构信息，或请求判断模型对行为进行分类。 例如，结构扫描器可能识别出已记录测试失败的情况，而判断扫描器则可能使用特定于某个研究领域的评分标准来对研究活动进行分类。 每个扫描器都通过 Scout 的 @scanner 装饰器进行注册，并通过一个层提供。 其结果会保存在 Scout 扫描存储中，并且可以转换为自定义的数据框。

sents.en: Custom scanners can extract structural information or ask judge models to classify behaviour.
sents.zh: 自定义扫描器可以提取结构信息，或请求判断模型对行为进行分类。

sents.en: For example, a structural scanner might identify recorded test failures, while a judged scanner might classify research activities using a family-specific rubric.
sents.zh: 例如，结构扫描器可能识别出已记录测试失败的情况，而判断扫描器则可能使用特定于某个研究领域的评分标准来对研究活动进行分类。

sents.zh: 每个扫描器都通过 Scout 的 @scanner 装饰器进行注册，并通过一个层提供。

sents.zh: 其结果会保存在 Scout 扫描存储中，并且可以转换为自定义的数据框。

paragraphs.en: For classifications of individual items, cohort_llm_scanner provides shared judging support ( Section A.5 ), including voting, optional verification and judge metadata. Tasks such as phase segmentation need additional logic to carry context between items; the built-in decision_phases scanner provides an implementation reference. Reusing the helper does not establish the validity of a custom rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 对于单个项目的分类，cohort_llm_scanner 提供了共享的评审支持（第 A.5 节），包括投票、可选验证和评审员元数据。 诸如阶段分割之类的任务需要额外的逻辑来在项目之间传递上下文；内置的 decision_phases 扫描器提供了一个实现参考。 重复使用该辅助工具并不能证明自定义评分标准的合理性。

sents.en: For classifications of individual items, cohort_llm_scanner provides shared judging support ( Section A.5 ), including voting, optional verification and judge metadata.
sents.zh: 对于单个项目的分类，cohort_llm_scanner 提供了共享的评审支持（第 A.5 节），包括投票、可选验证和评审员元数据。

sents.zh: 重复使用该辅助工具并不能证明自定义评分标准的合理性。

paragraphs.en: For custom classifications using cohort_llm_scanner , a loader can group several units into a window. With batch=True , the scanner judges that window in one initial call per member and retains separate results for each unit. Voting and any verifier review operate per unit. Results identify units with missing answers. For example, reasoning_turns(batch=N) with N > 1 N>1 groups up to N N eligible main-agent turns. This loader’s digests contain available recorded reasoning, message text, tool names and delegation information. Turns containing only readable reasoning are eligible. The loader excludes recognised OpenClaw failure placeholders and turns with no text, readable reasoning or delegation information. Custom loaders can define different classification units and eligibility rules.
paragraphs.zh: 对于使用 cohort_llm_scanner 的自定义分类，加载器可以将多个单元分组到一个窗口中。 当 batch=True 时，扫描器每次初始调用会针对每个成员判断该窗口，并为每个单元保留独立的结果。 投票和任何验证器审查均按单元进行。 结果会识别出缺少答案的单元。 例如，reasoning_turns(batch=N) 中，当 N > 1 时，会将最多 N 个合格的主智能体轮次分组处理。 此加载器的摘要包含可用的已记录推理、消息文本、工具名称和委托信息。 仅包含可读性推理的轮次才被视为合格。 该加载器会排除已识别的 OpenClaw 失败占位符以及没有文本、可读性推理或委托信息的轮次。 自定义加载器可以定义不同的分类单元和资格规则。

sents.en: For custom classifications using cohort_llm_scanner , a loader can group several units into a window.
sents.zh: 对于使用 cohort_llm_scanner 的自定义分类，加载器可以将多个单元分组到一个窗口中。

sents.en: With batch=True , the scanner judges that window in one initial call per member and retains separate results for each unit.
sents.zh: 当 batch=True 时，扫描器每次初始调用会针对每个成员判断该窗口，并为每个单元保留独立的结果。

sents.en: Voting and any verifier review operate per unit.
sents.zh: 投票和任何验证器审查均按单元进行。

sents.en: Results identify units with missing answers.
sents.zh: 结果会识别出缺少答案的单元。

sents.en: For example, reasoning_turns(batch=N) with N > 1 N>1 groups up to N N eligible main-agent turns.
sents.zh: 例如，reasoning_turns(batch=N) 中，当 N > 1 时，会将最多 N 个合格的主智能体轮次分组处理。

sents.en: This loader’s digests contain available recorded reasoning, message text, tool names and delegation information.
sents.zh: 此加载器的摘要包含可用的已记录推理、消息文本、工具名称和委托信息。

sents.en: Turns containing only readable reasoning are eligible.
sents.zh: 仅包含可读性推理的轮次才被视为合格。

sents.en: The loader excludes recognised OpenClaw failure placeholders and turns with no text, readable reasoning or delegation information.
sents.zh: 该加载器会排除已识别的 OpenClaw 失败占位符以及没有文本、可读性推理或委托信息的轮次。

sents.en: Custom loaders can define different classification units and eligibility rules.
sents.zh: 自定义加载器可以定义不同的分类单元和资格规则。

paragraphs.en: We recommend provenance and reliability review for every custom scanner. Record its inputs and method, the available evidence and any gaps. For structural scanners, document source coverage and extraction settings, distinguishing extracted, inferred and unavailable values; repeatability alone does not establish complete or correct extraction. The package offers an opt-in report audit for judged layers whose dataframes satisfy its audit contract. Other outputs require checks appropriate to their data and intended use; the package does not enforce universal audit coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们建议对每个自定义扫描器进行来源和可靠性审查。 记录其输入和方法、可用证据以及任何缺失之处。 对于结构扫描器，应记录来源覆盖范围和提取设置，区分已提取、推断和不可用的值；仅凭可重复性无法确定提取过程是否完整或正确。 该包为经过评估且数据框满足其审计合同的层提供可选的报告审计功能。 其他输出需要针对其数据和预期用途进行适当的检查；该包并不强制执行全面的审计覆盖。

sents.en: We recommend provenance and reliability review for every custom scanner.
sents.zh: 我们建议对每个自定义扫描器进行来源和可靠性审查。

sents.en: Record its inputs and method, the available evidence and any gaps.
sents.zh: 记录其输入和方法、可用证据以及任何缺失之处。

sents.en: The package offers an opt-in report audit for judged layers whose dataframes satisfy its audit contract.
sents.zh: 该包为经过评估且数据框满足其审计合同的层提供可选的报告审计功能。

sents.en: Other outputs require checks appropriate to their data and intended use; the package does not enforce universal audit coverage.
sents.zh: 其他输出需要针对其数据和预期用途进行适当的检查；该包并不强制执行全面的审计覆盖。

paragraphs.en: A layer’s section defines how its results appear in the report. Built-in report blocks display numeric turn-by-turn charts, categorical bands, spans, event markers, sortable tables and explanatory text. For further customisation, Component calls a user-supplied function that returns an Inspect Viz component. These interfaces let users present figures or other outputs from their own modelling or analysis of Transect’s dataframes. Turn-based displays use the shared timeline; a table or other summary need not be organised by turn.
paragraphs.zh: 某一层的部分定义了其结果在报告中的呈现方式。 内置的报告区块可显示按回合计量的图表、分类色带、区间、事件标记、可排序表格以及说明性文本。 如需进一步自定义，组件会调用由用户提供的函数，该函数返回一个“Inspect Viz”组件。 这些接口允许用户展示他们自己对 Transect 数据框进行建模或分析所得的图表或其他输出结果。 回合制显示使用共享的时间线；而表格或其他摘要则不必按回合组织。

sents.en: A layer’s section defines how its results appear in the report.
sents.zh: 某一层的部分定义了其结果在报告中的呈现方式。

sents.en: Built-in report blocks display numeric turn-by-turn charts, categorical bands, spans, event markers, sortable tables and explanatory text.
sents.zh: 内置的报告区块可显示按回合计量的图表、分类色带、区间、事件标记、可排序表格以及说明性文本。

sents.zh: 如需进一步自定义，组件会调用由用户提供的函数，该函数返回一个“Inspect Viz”组件。

sents.en: These interfaces let users present figures or other outputs from their own modelling or analysis of Transect’s dataframes.
sents.zh: 这些接口允许用户展示他们自己对 Transect 数据框进行建模或分析所得的图表或其他输出结果。

sents.en: Turn-based displays use the shared timeline; a table or other summary need not be organised by turn.
sents.zh: 回合制显示使用共享的时间线；而表格或其他摘要则不必按回合组织。

paragraphs.en: Blocks with dataframe inputs can read the layer’s dataframe or an explicitly supplied dataframe. If the dataframe includes transcript_id , rendering selects rows for the current transcript; otherwise it reuses the supplied data for each transcript. A custom Component function receives the current transcript’s context and must select any additional data it uses appropriately. Users should preserve transcript identity when an analysis is run-specific, so its outputs are not inadvertently repeated in other reports.
paragraphs.zh: 接受数据框输入的模块可以读取该层的数据框，或者使用显式提供的数据框。 如果数据框包含 transcript_id，渲染时将选择当前转录本的行；否则，每个转录本都会重复使用所提供的数据。 自定义的 Component 函数会接收当前转录本的上下文，并且必须恰当地选择其使用的任何附加数据。 当分析具有运行特定性时，用户应保留转录本的标识，以免其输出在其他报告中被无意重复。

sents.en: Blocks with dataframe inputs can read the layer’s dataframe or an explicitly supplied dataframe.
sents.zh: 接受数据框输入的模块可以读取该层的数据框，或者使用显式提供的数据框。

sents.en: If the dataframe includes transcript_id , rendering selects rows for the current transcript; otherwise it reuses the supplied data for each transcript.
sents.zh: 如果数据框包含 transcript_id，渲染时将选择当前转录本的行；否则，每个转录本都会重复使用所提供的数据。

sents.en: A custom Component function receives the current transcript’s context and must select any additional data it uses appropriately.
sents.zh: 自定义的 Component 函数会接收当前转录本的上下文，并且必须恰当地选择其使用的任何附加数据。

sents.en: Users should preserve transcript identity when an analysis is run-specific, so its outputs are not inadvertently repeated in other reports.
sents.zh: 当分析具有运行特定性时，用户应保留转录本的标识，以免其输出在其他报告中被无意重复。

paragraphs.en: A layer’s tags setting maps categorical columns in a per-turn dataframe to named tag groups. These tags appear on phase cards, provide filters for finding relevant episodes, and add grouping choices to the token-use display. For example, a custom research-activity classification can let reviewers filter cards by activity and inspect token use under the same categories. Numeric analysis outputs can instead be shown in charts or tables.
paragraphs.zh: 层的标签设置将每轮数据框中的分类列映射到带名称的标签组。 这些标签会显示在阶段卡上，提供用于查找相关回合的筛选条件，并为令牌使用显示添加分组选项。 例如，自定义的研究活动分类可以让评审员按活动筛选卡片，并检查同一类别下的令牌使用情况。 数值分析结果则可以选择以图表或表格形式展示。

sents.en: A layer’s tags setting maps categorical columns in a per-turn dataframe to named tag groups.
sents.zh: 层的标签设置将每轮数据框中的分类列映射到带名称的标签组。

sents.en: These tags appear on phase cards, provide filters for finding relevant episodes, and add grouping choices to the token-use display.
sents.zh: 这些标签会显示在阶段卡上，提供用于查找相关回合的筛选条件，并为令牌使用显示添加分组选项。

sents.en: For example, a custom research-activity classification can let reviewers filter cards by activity and inspect token use under the same categories.
sents.zh: 例如，自定义的研究活动分类可以让评审员按活动筛选卡片，并检查同一类别下的令牌使用情况。

sents.en: Numeric analysis outputs can instead be shown in charts or tables.
sents.zh: 数值分析结果则可以选择以图表或表格形式展示。

paragraphs.en: Users set section_order when generating or regenerating a report. It places the listed sections in the requested order, then appends any remaining sections in their default order. Each transcript’s reliability audit follows its ordered sections, and the run-wide Scan execution & coverage section closes the report. This controls report layout without changing the underlying classifications. The optional sensitivity setting adds a user-supplied protective marking to the report title and fixed banners at the top and bottom. No marking is added by default.
paragraphs.zh: 用户在生成或重新生成报告时会设置 section_order。 它会将列出的部分按指定顺序排列，然后将任何剩余部分按默认顺序追加到报告末尾。 每份转录本的可靠性审计都会按照其有序的部分进行，而整个运行范围的扫描执行与覆盖部分则作为报告的结尾。 这种方式可以在不改变底层分类的情况下控制报告布局。 可选的敏感度设置会在报告标题以及顶部和底部的固定横幅上添加由用户提供的保护性标记。 默认情况下不会添加任何标记。

sents.en: Users set section_order when generating or regenerating a report.
sents.zh: 用户在生成或重新生成报告时会设置 section_order。

sents.en: It places the listed sections in the requested order, then appends any remaining sections in their default order.
sents.zh: 它会将列出的部分按指定顺序排列，然后将任何剩余部分按默认顺序追加到报告末尾。

sents.zh: 每份转录本的可靠性审计都会按照其有序的部分进行，而整个运行范围的扫描执行与覆盖部分则作为报告的结尾。

sents.zh: 这种方式可以在不改变底层分类的情况下控制报告布局。

sents.en: The optional sensitivity setting adds a user-supplied protective marking to the report title and fixed banners at the top and bottom.
sents.zh: 可选的敏感度设置会在报告标题以及顶部和底部的固定横幅上添加由用户提供的保护性标记。

sents.en: No marking is added by default.
sents.zh: 默认情况下不会添加任何标记。

paragraphs.en: The shared timeline lets reviewers examine several aspects of the same episode. For example, they can inspect a context-compaction marker alongside a change in the activity label and a rise in token use, then return to the transcript to investigate what happened. The source records and scanner audit help reviewers assess how each signal was produced and what its available diagnostics support ( Section A.5 ). A missing signal may reflect incomplete logging, a scanner that did not run, or a classification failure; it does not by itself show that the behaviour was absent.
paragraphs.zh: 共享时间线让审核人员能够检查同一集内容的多个方面。 例如，他们可以检查一个上下文压缩标记，同时查看活动标签的变化和令牌使用量的增加，然后返回转录本调查当时发生了什么。 源记录与扫描器审计有助于审核人员评估每个信号是如何生成的，以及其可用的诊断支持信息（第 A.5 节）。 缺失的信号可能反映日志记录不完整、扫描器未运行或分类失败；仅凭这一点无法证明该行为并未发生。

sents.en: The shared timeline lets reviewers examine several aspects of the same episode.
sents.zh: 共享时间线让审核人员能够检查同一集内容的多个方面。

sents.en: For example, they can inspect a context-compaction marker alongside a change in the activity label and a rise in token use, then return to the transcript to investigate what happened.
sents.zh: 例如，他们可以检查一个上下文压缩标记，同时查看活动标签的变化和令牌使用量的增加，然后返回转录本调查当时发生了什么。

sents.en: The source records and scanner audit help reviewers assess how each signal was produced and what its available diagnostics support ( Section A.5 ).
sents.zh: 源记录与扫描器审计有助于审核人员评估每个信号是如何生成的，以及其可用的诊断支持信息（第 A.5 节）。

sents.en: A missing signal may reflect incomplete logging, a scanner that did not run, or a classification failure; it does not by itself show that the behaviour was absent.
sents.zh: 缺失的信号可能反映日志记录不完整、扫描器未运行或分类失败；仅凭这一点无法证明该行为并未发生。

paragraphs.en: Signals appearing near one another on the timeline do not establish a causal relationship. Nor do several outputs necessarily provide independent evidence: they may share transcript excerpts, category definitions, judge models or derived values. For example, token use grouped by phase depends on the phase labels and cannot independently verify those labels.
paragraphs.zh: 时间线上彼此邻近出现的信号并不构成因果关系。 同样，多个输出结果也不必然提供独立证据：它们可能共享转录片段、类别定义、裁判模型或派生值。 例如，按阶段分组的标记使用依赖于阶段标签，无法独立验证这些标签。

sents.en: Signals appearing near one another on the timeline do not establish a causal relationship.
sents.zh: 时间线上彼此邻近出现的信号并不构成因果关系。

sents.en: Nor do several outputs necessarily provide independent evidence: they may share transcript excerpts, category definitions, judge models or derived values.
sents.zh: 同样，多个输出结果也不必然提供独立证据：它们可能共享转录片段、类别定义、裁判模型或派生值。

sents.en: For example, token use grouped by phase depends on the phase labels and cannot independently verify those labels.
sents.zh: 例如，按阶段分组的标记使用依赖于阶段标签，无法独立验证这些标签。

paragraphs.en: Related signals can still help reviewers identify patterns, inconsistencies and questions for follow-up. When drawing a conclusion from several signals, document their shared inputs and assumptions and assess what evidence each adds. The report does not automatically measure dependence or establish the validity of the conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 相关信号仍然可以帮助评审员识别模式、不一致之处以及后续需要跟进的问题。 在根据多个信号得出结论时，应记录它们的共同输入和假设，并评估每个信号所增加的证据价值。 该报告不会自动衡量依赖关系或确定结论的有效性。

sents.en: Related signals can still help reviewers identify patterns, inconsistencies and questions for follow-up.
sents.zh: 相关信号仍然可以帮助评审员识别模式、不一致之处以及后续需要跟进的问题。

sents.en: When drawing a conclusion from several signals, document their shared inputs and assumptions and assess what evidence each adds.
sents.zh: 在根据多个信号得出结论时，应记录它们的共同输入和假设，并评估每个信号所增加的证据价值。

sents.en: The report does not automatically measure dependence or establish the validity of the conclusion.
sents.zh: 该报告不会自动衡量依赖关系或确定结论的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Retain the source transcripts, selected sample and epochs, family Spec, judging settings, custom-layer definitions and exact scan directory. Record the package revision and relevant dependency and provider-model versions where available, including local code changes. Together, these records distinguish changes in the evaluation evidence from changes in how it was processed.
paragraphs.zh: 保留源转录文本、选定的样本和轮次、家族规格、评判设置、自定义层定义以及确切的扫描目录。 记录软件包版本以及相关的依赖项和提供商模型版本（如已知），包括本地代码变更。 这些记录共同区分了评估证据的变化与处理该证据方式的变化。

sents.en: Retain the source transcripts, selected sample and epochs, family Spec, judging settings, custom-layer definitions and exact scan directory.
sents.zh: 保留源转录文本、选定的样本和轮次、家族规格、评判设置、自定义层定义以及确切的扫描目录。

sents.en: Record the package revision and relevant dependency and provider-model versions where available, including local code changes.
sents.zh: 记录软件包版本以及相关的依赖项和提供商模型版本（如已知），包括本地代码变更。

sents.en: Together, these records distinguish changes in the evaluation evidence from changes in how it was processed.
sents.zh: 这些记录共同区分了评估证据的变化与处理该证据方式的变化。

paragraphs.en: Stored scanner results and dataframes carry useful provenance, including recorded judge identities, label definitions and decision sources. They do not replace the complete analysis configuration or a record of the software environment.
paragraphs.zh: 存储的扫描结果和数据框包含有用的来源信息，包括记录在案的评审员身份、标签定义和决策来源。 它们不会取代完整的分析配置或软件环境的记录。

sents.en: Stored scanner results and dataframes carry useful provenance, including recorded judge identities, label definitions and decision sources.
sents.zh: 存储的扫描结果和数据框包含有用的来源信息，包括记录在案的评审员身份、标签定义和决策来源。

sents.en: They do not replace the complete analysis configuration or a record of the software environment.
sents.zh: 它们不会取代完整的分析配置或软件环境的记录。

paragraphs.en: Reloading a scan with load() rebuilds its dataframes from stored scanner results without calling judge models. A new transect() invocation performs another scan, but judge calls can reuse Inspect’s response cache when their cache keys match. Repeated calls within a k k -roll configuration use separate roll-specific cache scopes, so a later run can reuse the response from each corresponding roll. A new scan directory alone does not ensure fresh judge responses.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 load() 重新加载扫描操作会从已存储的扫描器结果中重建其数据框，而无需调用判断模型。 新的 transect() 调用会执行另一次扫描，但如果缓存键匹配，判断调用可以重用 Inspect 的响应缓存。 在 k k -roll 配置中重复调用会使用独立的、针对每次 roll 的缓存作用域，因此后续运行可以重用每个对应 roll 的响应。 仅创建一个新的扫描目录并不能保证获得全新的判断响应。

sents.en: Reloading a scan with load() rebuilds its dataframes from stored scanner results without calling judge models.
sents.zh: 使用 load() 重新加载扫描操作会从已存储的扫描器结果中重建其数据框，而无需调用判断模型。

sents.en: A new transect() invocation performs another scan, but judge calls can reuse Inspect’s response cache when their cache keys match.
sents.zh: 新的 transect() 调用会执行另一次扫描，但如果缓存键匹配，判断调用可以重用 Inspect 的响应缓存。

sents.en: Repeated calls within a k k -roll configuration use separate roll-specific cache scopes, so a later run can reuse the response from each corresponding roll.
sents.zh: 在 k k -roll 配置中重复调用会使用独立的、针对每次 roll 的缓存作用域，因此后续运行可以重用每个对应 roll 的响应。

sents.en: A new scan directory alone does not ensure fresh judge responses.
sents.zh: 仅创建一个新的扫描目录并不能保证获得全新的判断响应。

paragraphs.en: For each repeat intended to assess judging variation, set INSPECT_CACHE_DIR to a new, empty directory before starting its analysis process. Verify that relevant calls did not replay cached responses. Caching remains active within each process. This setting controls Inspect’s model-response cache; custom scanners may have other reuse mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次旨在评估判断差异的重复测试，在开始分析过程之前，请将 INSPECT_CACHE_DIR 设置为一个全新的空目录。 验证相关调用是否未重放缓存的响应。 缓存机制在每个进程内部仍然保持活跃状态。 此设置控制 Inspect 的模型响应缓存；自定义扫描器可能具有其他重用机制。

sents.en: For each repeat intended to assess judging variation, set INSPECT_CACHE_DIR to a new, empty directory before starting its analysis process.
sents.zh: 对于每次旨在评估判断差异的重复测试，在开始分析过程之前，请将 INSPECT_CACHE_DIR 设置为一个全新的空目录。

sents.en: Verify that relevant calls did not replay cached responses.
sents.zh: 验证相关调用是否未重放缓存的响应。

sents.en: Caching remains active within each process.
sents.zh: 缓存机制在每个进程内部仍然保持活跃状态。

sents.en: This setting controls Inspect’s model-response cache; custom scanners may have other reuse mechanisms.
sents.zh: 此设置控制 Inspect 的模型响应缓存；自定义扫描器可能具有其他重用机制。

paragraphs.en: Structural extraction makes no model calls, but its outputs can change with the source data, adapter or scanner implementation. Fresh judged outputs may vary even with unchanged settings; identical outputs are also possible and do not establish that a model or pipeline is deterministic.
paragraphs.zh: 结构提取不会调用任何模型，但其输出可能会随源数据、适配器或扫描器实现的不同而改变。 即使设置未变，新判定的输出也可能存在差异；输出完全相同的情况同样可能发生，但这并不能证明某个模型或流程是确定性的。

sents.en: Structural extraction makes no model calls, but its outputs can change with the source data, adapter or scanner implementation.
sents.zh: 结构提取不会调用任何模型，但其输出可能会随源数据、适配器或扫描器实现的不同而改变。

sents.en: Fresh judged outputs may vary even with unchanged settings; identical outputs are also possible and do not establish that a model or pipeline is deterministic.
sents.zh: 即使设置未变，新判定的输出也可能存在差异；输出完全相同的情况同样可能发生，但这并不能证明某个模型或流程是确定性的。

paragraphs.en: Each transect() invocation on OpenClaw JSONL input imports the supplied files into a fresh transcript snapshot database under the scans directory. Duplicate transcript identifiers across the supplied files raise an error. Loading a stored scan does not repeat the import.
paragraphs.zh: 对 OpenClaw JSONL 输入中的每个 transect() 调用，都会将提供的文件导入 scans 目录下的一个全新的转录快照数据库。 如果提供的文件中存在重复的转录标识符，则会引发错误。 加载已存储的扫描时不会重复执行导入操作。

sents.en: Each transect() invocation on OpenClaw JSONL input imports the supplied files into a fresh transcript snapshot database under the scans directory.
sents.zh: 对 OpenClaw JSONL 输入中的每个 transect() 调用，都会将提供的文件导入 scans 目录下的一个全新的转录快照数据库。

sents.en: Duplicate transcript identifiers across the supplied files raise an error.
sents.zh: 如果提供的文件中存在重复的转录标识符，则会引发错误。

sents.en: Loading a stored scan does not repeat the import.
sents.zh: 加载已存储的扫描时不会重复执行导入操作。

paragraphs.en: Before comparing outputs, check that they refer to the same source transcripts and align the relevant sample, epoch, turn or span identifiers. Record changes to the vocabulary, input processing and judging settings. A change in category definitions or turn numbering can make a direct label comparison misleading.
paragraphs.zh: 在比较输出结果之前，请确认它们引用的是相同的源转录文本，并对相关的样本、轮次、回合或片段标识符进行对齐。 记录词汇表、输入处理及判断设置中的变更。 类别定义或回合编号的变更可能导致直接比较标签时产生误解。

sents.en: Before comparing outputs, check that they refer to the same source transcripts and align the relevant sample, epoch, turn or span identifiers.
sents.zh: 在比较输出结果之前，请确认它们引用的是相同的源转录文本，并对相关的样本、轮次、回合或片段标识符进行对齐。

sents.en: Record changes to the vocabulary, input processing and judging settings.
sents.zh: 记录词汇表、输入处理及判断设置中的变更。

sents.en: A change in category definitions or turn numbering can make a direct label comparison misleading.
sents.zh: 类别定义或回合编号的变更可能导致直接比较标签时产生误解。

paragraphs.en: When comparing configurations whose judged outputs can vary, estimate unchanged-configuration variation using fresh judgements under the relevant conditions. This provides context for a changed configuration; it does not supply a universal tolerance band or establish that a difference is an improvement. Comparisons intended to establish greater classification accuracy need an appropriate external assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 在比较其判断结果可能不同的配置时，应在相关条件下使用新的判断来估计未变更配置的变动情况。 这为变更后的配置提供了背景信息；但它并未提供一个通用的容差范围，也未证明差异就一定意味着改进。 旨在确定更高分类准确性的比较需要适当的外部评估。

sents.en: When comparing configurations whose judged outputs can vary, estimate unchanged-configuration variation using fresh judgements under the relevant conditions.
sents.zh: 在比较其判断结果可能不同的配置时，应在相关条件下使用新的判断来估计未变更配置的变动情况。

sents.en: This provides context for a changed configuration; it does not supply a universal tolerance band or establish that a difference is an improvement.
sents.zh: 这为变更后的配置提供了背景信息；但它并未提供一个通用的容差范围，也未证明差异就一定意味着改进。

sents.en: Comparisons intended to establish greater classification accuracy need an appropriate external assessment.
sents.zh: 旨在确定更高分类准确性的比较需要适当的外部评估。

paragraphs.en: Document why a family uses particular categories, thresholds and judge settings, including their sources, assumptions and changes between analyses. Keep expert-supplied choices distinguishable from defaults and generated suggestions. The Spec and interface checks constrain the form of the configuration; they do not establish the scientific justification for its contents. Keep this documentation alongside the Spec and stored analysis, including the supporting evidence and its limits.
paragraphs.zh: 记录一个家庭为何使用特定的分类、阈值和判断设置，包括这些设置的来源、假设以及不同分析之间的变化。 确保专家提供的选择与默认设置和生成的建议能够区分开来。 规格说明和接口检查会限制配置的形式，但不会为其内容提供科学依据。 将此文档与规格说明和已存储的分析结果一并保留，包括支持性证据及其局限性。

sents.en: Document why a family uses particular categories, thresholds and judge settings, including their sources, assumptions and changes between analyses.
sents.zh: 记录一个家庭为何使用特定的分类、阈值和判断设置，包括这些设置的来源、假设以及不同分析之间的变化。

sents.en: Keep expert-supplied choices distinguishable from defaults and generated suggestions.
sents.zh: 确保专家提供的选择与默认设置和生成的建议能够区分开来。

sents.en: The Spec and interface checks constrain the form of the configuration; they do not establish the scientific justification for its contents.
sents.zh: 规格说明和接口检查会限制配置的形式，但不会为其内容提供科学依据。

sents.en: Keep this documentation alongside the Spec and stored analysis, including the supporting evidence and its limits.
sents.zh: 将此文档与规格说明和已存储的分析结果一并保留，包括支持性证据及其局限性。

paragraphs.en: The package ships skills for coding assistants that guide common tasks. using-transect covers Spec authoring, running an analysis, reading reports and analysing dataframes. transect-diagnostics guides investigation of disagreements, missing outputs and judging settings, including the label-renaming diagnostic. add-a-layer explains how to add scanners, report elements, tags and audit entries. custom-ui guides separate presentations of the results, including how to retain provenance, judging diagnostics and missing-data information. These skills provide instructions and examples; users remain responsible for selecting behavioural categories, reviewing proposed configurations and definitions, recording their sources and assumptions, and interpreting results.
paragraphs.zh: 该软件包为编码助手提供了技能，用于指导常见任务。using-transect 涵盖了规范编写、运行分析、阅读报告和分析数据框。transect-diagnostics 指导如何调查分歧、处理缺失输出和评估设置，包括标签重命名诊断。add-a-layer 说明了如何添加扫描器、报告元素、标签和审计条目。custom-ui 指导如何以独立方式呈现结果，包括如何保留来源信息、评估诊断和缺失数据信息。 这些技能提供了说明和示例；用户仍需负责选择行为类别、审查建议的配置和定义、记录其来源和假设，并解释结果。

sents.en: The package ships skills for coding assistants that guide common tasks. using-transect covers Spec authoring, running an analysis, reading reports and analysing dataframes. transect-diagnostics guides investigation of disagreements, missing outputs and judging settings, including the label-renaming diagnostic. add-a-layer explains how to add scanners, report elements, tags and audit entries. custom-ui guides separate presentations of the results, including how to retain provenance, judging diagnostics and missing-data information.
sents.zh: 该软件包为编码助手提供了技能，用于指导常见任务。using-transect 涵盖了规范编写、运行分析、阅读报告和分析数据框。transect-diagnostics 指导如何调查分歧、处理缺失输出和评估设置，包括标签重命名诊断。add-a-layer 说明了如何添加扫描器、报告元素、标签和审计条目。custom-ui 指导如何以独立方式呈现结果，包括如何保留来源信息、评估诊断和缺失数据信息。

sents.en: These skills provide instructions and examples; users remain responsible for selecting behavioural categories, reviewing proposed configurations and definitions, recording their sources and assumptions, and interpreting results.
sents.zh: 这些技能提供了说明和示例；用户仍需负责选择行为类别、审查建议的配置和定义、记录其来源和假设，并解释结果。

paragraphs.en: Running python -m transect.skills install from the project directory copies the packaged skills into .claude/skills for Claude Code. Development-repository hooks for regression checks and other working practices are separate from this installer. They should not be assumed to run in a user’s package installation or another coding-assistant environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在项目目录中运行 `python -m transect.skills install`，会将打包好的技能复制到 `.claude/skills` 文件夹中，供 Claude Code 使用。 用于回归测试和其他工作惯例的开发仓库钩子与此安装程序无关。 不应假设这些钩子会在用户的软件包安装过程中或另一个编码助手环境中运行。

sents.en: Running python -m transect.skills install from the project directory copies the packaged skills into .claude/skills for Claude Code.
sents.zh: 在项目目录中运行 `python -m transect.skills install`，会将打包好的技能复制到 `.claude/skills` 文件夹中，供 Claude Code 使用。

sents.en: Development-repository hooks for regression checks and other working practices are separate from this installer.
sents.zh: 用于回归测试和其他工作惯例的开发仓库钩子与此安装程序无关。

sents.zh: 不应假设这些钩子会在用户的软件包安装过程中或另一个编码助手环境中运行。

paragraphs.en: Judged-analysis cost depends on input text, the number of classification units, judging regime, verifier coverage, narration and response-cache reuse. Longer transcripts may require more phase-classification chunks; additional sub-agent spans or custom items may require more classifications. Repeated calls and cohort members add judging work, while cached responses can avoid provider requests. API charges depend on the chosen models’ input, output and cache prices. Tokens used for analysis are separate from the evaluated agent’s token totals.
paragraphs.zh: 判断分析的成本取决于输入文本、分类单元的数量、判断机制、验证器覆盖范围、叙述以及响应缓存的重复使用。 较长的转录文本可能需要更多的阶段分类片段；额外的子智能体跨度或自定义项也可能需要更多分类。 重复调用和群体成员会增加判断工作量，而缓存的响应可以避免向提供商发起请求。 API 费用取决于所选模型在输入、输出和缓存方面的价格。 分析所用的令牌与所评估智能体的总令牌数分开计算。

sents.en: Judged-analysis cost depends on input text, the number of classification units, judging regime, verifier coverage, narration and response-cache reuse.
sents.zh: 判断分析的成本取决于输入文本、分类单元的数量、判断机制、验证器覆盖范围、叙述以及响应缓存的重复使用。

sents.en: Longer transcripts may require more phase-classification chunks; additional sub-agent spans or custom items may require more classifications.
sents.zh: 较长的转录文本可能需要更多的阶段分类片段；额外的子智能体跨度或自定义项也可能需要更多分类。

sents.en: Repeated calls and cohort members add judging work, while cached responses can avoid provider requests.
sents.zh: 重复调用和群体成员会增加判断工作量，而缓存的响应可以避免向提供商发起请求。

sents.en: API charges depend on the chosen models’ input, output and cache prices.
sents.zh: API 费用取决于所选模型在输入、输出和缓存方面的价格。

sents.en: Tokens used for analysis are separate from the evaluated agent’s token totals.
sents.zh: 分析所用的令牌与所评估智能体的总令牌数分开计算。

paragraphs.en: Structural analysis requires computation, storage and report generation without calling judge models. Concurrency, batching and provider limits also affect runtime, which cannot be inferred directly from token counts or API charges. Custom-scanner batching groups initial classifications into shared calls ( Section A.6 ); verifier reviews can add calls. No speed or cost advantage is established here.
paragraphs.zh: 结构分析需要进行计算、存储和报告生成，而无需调用评判模型。 并发处理、批量处理和提供商限制也会影响运行时间，而这些无法直接从令牌数量或 API 费用中推断出来。 自定义扫描器的批量处理会将初始分类分组为共享调用（第 A.6 节）；验证审查可能会增加额外的调用。 此处并未确立任何速度或成本上的优势。

sents.en: Structural analysis requires computation, storage and report generation without calling judge models.
sents.zh: 结构分析需要进行计算、存储和报告生成，而无需调用评判模型。

sents.en: Concurrency, batching and provider limits also affect runtime, which cannot be inferred directly from token counts or API charges.
sents.zh: 并发处理、批量处理和提供商限制也会影响运行时间，而这些无法直接从令牌数量或 API 费用中推断出来。

sents.en: Custom-scanner batching groups initial classifications into shared calls ( Section A.6 ); verifier reviews can add calls.
sents.zh: 自定义扫描器的批量处理会将初始分类分组为共享调用（第 A.6 节）；验证审查可能会增加额外的调用。

sents.en: No speed or cost advantage is established here.
sents.zh: 此处并未确立任何速度或成本上的优势。

paragraphs.en: Users can add scanners, relevant context or role-specific rubrics, or choose alternative judge models, to address further evaluation questions through the shared tables and report. These additions can also increase cost, disagreement and shared errors; more context or more judges need not improve classification quality.
paragraphs.zh: 用户可以通过共享表格和报告添加扫描器、相关上下文或特定角色的评分标准，或者选择替代的评判模型，以进一步回答评估问题。 这些添加内容也可能增加成本、分歧和共享错误；更多的上下文或更多的评判者并不一定能提升分类质量。

paragraphs.en: Provenance and reliability audits help users inspect outputs, identify missing evidence and select findings for human review. Users can then assess whether further analysis is worth its cost and what confidence the evidence warrants. Demonstrating improved accuracy, reviewer performance or cost-effectiveness requires an appropriate comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 来源和可靠性审计有助于用户检查输出结果、识别缺失的证据，并选择需要人工审核的发现。 随后，用户可以评估进一步分析是否值得其成本，以及这些证据能带来多大的可信度。 要证明准确性、审核员表现或成本效益有所提升，需要进行适当的比较。
